1413.e: Now listen to the Tale of King Azam,

1413.g: ਕਿ ਹੁਸਨਲ ਜਮਾਲ ਅਸਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੩॥
1413.t: k husanal jamaal asat saahib kareem ||3||
1413.e: Who was magnanimous and compassionate.(3)

1413.g: ਕਿ ਸੂਰਤ ਜਮਾਲ ਅਸਤੁ ਹੁਸਨਲ ਤਮਾਮ ॥
1413.t: k soorat jamaal asat husanal tamaam ||
1413.e: With perfect posture, his countenance radiated.

1413.g: ਹਮਹ ਰੋਜ਼ ਆਸ਼ਾਯਸ਼ੇ ਰੋਦ ਜਾਮ ॥੪॥
1413.t: hameh roz aashaayashe rodh jaam ||4||
1413.e: Whole day he used to spend listening to the musical renderings of Ragas, and quaffing cups of wine.(4)

1413.g: ਕਿ ਸਰਹੰਗ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਜਿ ਫ਼ਰਜ਼ਾਨਗੀ ॥
1413.t: k saraha(n)g dhaanash j pharazaanagee ||
1413.e: He was renown for his wisdom,

1413.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਮਸਲਿਹਤ ਮੌਜ ਮਰਦਾਨਗੀ ॥੫॥
1413.t: k az masalihat mauaj maradhaanagee ||5||
1413.e: And was famous for magnanimity of his bravery.(5)

1413.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਬਾਨੂਏ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਮਾਹੇ ਜਵਾ ॥
1413.t: vazaa baanooe ham ch maahe javaa ||
1413.e: He had a moon-like pretty wife,

1413.g: ਕਿ ਕੁਰਬਾ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਹਰ ਕਸੇ ਨਾਜ਼ਦਾ ॥੬॥
1413.t: k kurabaa shavadh har kase naazadhaa ||6||
1413.e: The people admired the exquisiteness of his preference.(6)

1413.g: ਕਿ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਰੰਗ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਖ਼ੋਇ ਓ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਜਮਾਲ ॥
1413.t: k khhush ra(n)g khhush khhoi o khhush jamaal ||
1413.e: She was very beautiful and possessed sober temperament with captivating features.

1413.g: ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਆਵਾਜ਼ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਰਗੀ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਖ਼ਿਯਾਲ ॥੭॥
1413.t: khhush aavaaz khhush khhavaiaaragee khhush khhiyaal ||7||
1413.e: Also she enjoyed sweat voice, dressed herself profusely, and was chaste in her thought.(7)

1413.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਕਿ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਖ਼ੋਇ ਖ਼ੂਬੀ ਜਹਾ ॥
1413.t: b dheedhan k khhush khhoi khhoobee jahaa ||

1413.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਹਰਫ਼ਾਤ ਕਰਦਨ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੋ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥੮॥
1413.t: z haraphaat karadhan khhusho khhush zubaa ||8||

1413.g: ਦੁ ਪਿਸਰਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਬੂਦ ਚੂੰ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ ਮਾਹ ॥
1413.t: dh pisarash azaa boodh choo(n) shamash maeh ||
1413.e: She had two sons, called Sun and Moon.

1413.g: ਕਿ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਤਬੀਯਤ ਹਕੀਕਤ ਗਵਾਹ ॥੯॥
1413.t: k rauashan tabeeyat hakeekat gavaeh ||9||
1413.e: Intellectually content, they always aspired for the truth.(9)

1413.g: ਕਿ ਗੁਸਤਾਖ਼ ਦਸਤ ਅਸਤ ਚਾਲਾਕ ਜੰਗ ॥
1413.t: k gusataakhh dhasat asat chaalaak ja(n)g ||
1413.e: Being very fast in their hand movements, they were clever in fights.

1413.g: ਬ ਵਕਤੇ ਤਰੱਦਦ ਚੁ ਸ਼ੇਰੋ ਨਿਹੰਗ ॥੧੦॥
1413.t: b vakate tara'dhadh ch shero niha(n)g ||10||
1413.e: They were like the roaring lions and vicious like crocodiles.(10)

1413.g: ਦੁ ਪੀਲ ਅਫ਼ਕਨੋ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਅਫ਼ਕਨ ਅਸਤ ॥
1413.t: dh peel aphakano ham ch sher aphakan asat ||
1413.e: Those lion-hearted could subdue the elephants,

1413.g: ਬ ਵਕਤੇ ਵਗਾ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਰੋਈਂ ਤਨ ਅਸਤ ॥੧੧॥
1413.t: b vakate vagaa sher roiee(n) tan asat ||11||
1413.e: And during the wars they became embodiment of steel.(11)

1413.g: ਯਕੇ ਖ਼ੂਬ ਰੋਇ ਓ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਤਨ ਚੁ ਸੀਮ ॥
1413.t: yake khhoob roi o dhig(h)r tan ch seem ||
1413.e: Not only they had attractive features, their bodies gleamed like silver.

1413.g: ਦੁ ਸੂਰਤ ਸਜ਼ਾਵਾਰ ਆਜ਼ਮ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥੧੨॥
1413.t: dh soorat sazaavaar aazam azeem ||12||
1413.e: Both the figures called for highest acclaims.(12)

1413.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਮਾਦਰੇ ਬਰਕਸ ਆਸੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1413.t: vazaa maadhare barakas aasuphateh gashat ||
1413.e: Their mother fell in love with a stranger,

1413.g: ਚੁ ਮਰਦਸਤ ਗੁਲ ਹਮ ਚੁਨੀ ਗੁਲ ਪ੍ਰਸਤ ॥੧੩॥
1413.t: ch maradhasat gul ham chunee gul prasat ||13||
1413.e: Because that man was like a flower, and their mother was in search of such a flower.(13)

1413.g: ਸ਼ਬੰ ਗਾਹ ਦਰ ਖ਼ਾਬਗਾਹ ਆਮਦੰਦ ॥
1413.t: shaba(n) gaeh dhar khhaabagaeh aamadha(n)dh ||
1413.e: They had just come into their sleeping chamber,

1413.g: ਕਿ ਜ਼ੋਰਾਵਰਾ ਦਰ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਆਮਦੰਦ ॥੧੪॥
1413.t: k zoraavaraa dhar nigaeh aamadha(n)dh ||14||
1413.e: When they caught sight of both the undaunted ones.(14)

1413.g: ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਪਸ ਪੇਸ਼ ਖ਼ੁਰਦੋ ਕਲਾ ॥
1413.t: bukhhaadha(n)dh pas pesh khhuradho kalaa ||
1413.e: They (their mother and her lover) called in both the younger and older one,

1413.g: ਮਯੋ ਰੋਦ ਰਾਮਸ਼ ਗਿਰਾ ਰਾ ਹੁਮਾ ॥੧੫॥
1413.t: mayo rodh raamash giraa raa humaa ||15||
1413.e: And entertained them with wine and music through the Raga Singers.(15)

1413.g: ਬਿਦਾਨਿਸਤ ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਮਸਤੀਯਸ਼ ਮਸਤ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1413.t: bidhaanisat k az masateeyash masat gashat ||
1413.e: When she realised that they were absolutely intoxicated,

1413.g: ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਤੇਗ਼ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਦਸਤ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਸ਼ਿਕਸਤ ॥੧੬॥
1413.t: bizadh teg(h) khhudh dhasat har dho shikasat ||16||
1413.e: She stood up and cut their heads with the sword.(16)

1413.g: ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਦਸਤਸ਼ ਸਰੇ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ਜ਼ੋਰ ॥
1413.t: bizadh har dho dhasatash sare khhesh zor ||
1413.e: Then she started to beat her head with both her hands,

1413.g: ਬ ਜੁੰਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਬ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਸ਼ੋਰ ॥੧੭॥
1413.t: b ju(n)bash dharaamadh b karadha(n)dh shor ||17||
1413.e: And began to tremble and shout very loudly,(17)

1413.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਕਿ ਏ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾਨ ਪਾਕ ॥
1413.t: bigoyadh k e musalamaanaan paak ||
1413.e: She shouted, ‘Oh, you the pious Muslims,

1413.g: ਚਿਰਾ ਚੂੰ ਕਿ ਕੁਸ਼ਤੀ ਅਜ਼ੀ ਜਾਮਹ ਚਾਕ ॥੧੮॥
1413.t: chiraa choo(n) k kushatee azee jaameh chaak ||18||
1413.e: ‘How they have cut each other like the scissors cut the clothes?(18)

1413.g: ਬਿਖ਼ੁਰਦੰਦ ਮਯ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਆਂ ਮਸਤ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1413.t: bikhhuradha(n)dh may har dh aa(n) masat gashat ||
1413.e: ‘Both of them drenched themselves in wine,

1413.g: ਗਿਰਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਪੌਲਾਦ ਦਸਤ ॥੧੯॥
1413.t: giraphata(n)dh shamasher paualaadh dhasat ||19||
1413.e: ‘And took the swords in their hands,(19)

1413.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਰਾ ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਆਂ ਬਈ ਆਂ ਜਦੰਦ ॥
1413.t: k iee(n) raa bizadh aa(n) biee aa(n) jadha(n)dh ||
1413.e: ‘One hit the other and, right in front of my eyes,

1413.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਹ ਮਰਾ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਈਂ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਹ ਅੰਦ ॥੨੦॥
1413.t: b dheedheh maraa har dh iee(n) kushateh a(n)dh ||20||
1413.e: they murdered each other.(20)

1413.g: ਦਰੇਗਾ ਮਰਾ ਜਾ ਜ਼ਿਮੀ ਹਮ ਨ ਦਾਦ ॥
1413.t: dharegaa maraa jaa zimee ham na dhaadh ||
1413.e: ‘Hai, why didn’t earth give way to obscure myself in there,

1413.g: ਨ ਦਹਲੀਜ਼ ਦੋਜ਼ਖ਼ ਮਰਾ ਰਹ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੨੧॥
1413.t: n dhahaleez dhozakhh maraa reh kushaadh ||21||
1413.e: ‘Even the door of the hell has been closed for me.(21)

1413.g: ਦੁ ਚਸ਼ਮੇ ਮਰਾ ਈਂ ਚਿ ਗਰਦੀਦ ਈਂ ॥
1413.t: dh chashame maraa iee(n) ch garadheedh iee(n) ||
1413.e: ‘Down with my eyes,

1413.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਦੀਦਹੇ ਖ਼ੂਨ ਈਂ ਦੀਦ ਈਂ ॥੨੨॥
1413.t: k iee(n) dheedhahe khhoon iee(n) dheedh iee(n) ||22||
1413.e: ‘The eyes which were watching when they killed each other.(22)

1413.g: ਬਿਹਜ਼ ਮਨ ਤਨੇ ਤਰਕ ਦੁਨੀਯਾ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1413.t: bihaz man tane tarak dhuneeyaa kunam ||
1413.e: ‘You (my boys) abandoned this world,

1413.g: ਫ਼ਕੀਰੇ ਸ਼ਵਮ ਮੁਲਕ ਚੀਂ ਮੇ ਰਵਮ ॥੨੩॥
1413.t: phakeere shavam mulak chee(n) me ravam ||23||
1413.e: ‘I will, now, become an ascetic and go to the Country of China.’(23)

1413.g: ਬਿ ਗ਼ੁਫਤ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਕੁਨਦ ਜਾਮਹ ਚਾਕ ॥
1413.t: b g(h)ufat iee(n) sukhhan raa kunadh jaameh chaak ||
1413.e: Pronouncing thus, she tore off her clothes,

1413.g: ਰਵਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਸੂਏ ਦਸਤਖ਼ਤ ਚਾਕ ਚਾਕ ॥੨੪॥
1413.t: ravaa shudh sooe dhasatakhhat chaak chaak ||24||
1413.e: And proceeded towards the bewilderment.(24)

1413.g: ਕਿ ਓ ਜਾ ਬਦੀਦੰਦ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਖ਼ਾਬਗਾਹ ॥
1413.t: k o jaa badheedha(n)dh khhush khhaabagaeh ||
1413.e: She went to a location where there was restful place.

1413.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤਹ ਅਸਤੁ ਬਰ ਗਾਉ ਬਾ ਜ਼ਨ ਚੁ ਮਾਹ ॥੨੫॥
1413.t: nishasateh asat bar gaau baa zan ch maeh ||25||
1413.e: There, on the back of a bullock, she saw Shiva, along with women as pretty as the moon.(25)

1413.g: ਬ ਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਕਿ ਏ ਨੇਕ ਜ਼ਨ ॥
1413.t: b purasheedh o raa k e nek zan ||
1413.e: He asked her, ‘Oh, you the kind woman,

1414.g: ਹਮਾਯੂ ਦਰਖ਼ਤੇ ਚੁ ਸਰਵੇ ਚਮਨ ॥੨੬॥
1414.t: hamaayoo dharakhhate ch sarave chaman ||26||
1414.e: ‘Slim and tall like a cypress tree, who are you?(26)

1414.g: ਕਿ ਹੂਰੋ ਪਰੀ ਤੋ ਚੁ ਨੂਰੇ ਜਹਾ ॥
1414.t: k hooro paree to ch noore jahaa ||
1414.e: ‘Are you either a Soul or a Fairy?

1414.g: ਕਿ ਮਾਹੇ ਫ਼ਲਕ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਾ ॥੨੭॥
1414.t: k maahe phalak aaphataabe yamaa ||27||
1414.e: ‘Are you either the moon in the sky or sun over the earth?’(27)

1414.g: ਨ ਹੂਰੋ ਪਰੀਅਮ ਨ ਨੂਰੇ ਜਹਾ ॥
1414.t: n hooro pareeam na noore jahaa ||
1414.e: (She replied), ‘Neither I am Fairy, nor an Enlightener of the world.

1414.g: ਮਨਮ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਿਜਾ ਬਿਲਸਿਤਾ ॥੨੮॥
1414.t: manam dhukhhatare shaahijaa bilasitaa ||28||
1414.e: ‘I am the daughter of the King of Zablistan.’(28)

1414.g: ਬ ਪੁਰਸ਼ਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਪਰਸਤਸ਼ ਨ ਮੂਦ ॥
1414.t: b purashash dharaamadh parasatash na moodh ||
1414.e: Then, on learning (that he was god Shiva), she supplicated,

1414.g: ਬਨਿਜ਼ਦਸ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਰਾ ਬ ਫ਼ੁਰਸਤ ਕਸੂਦ ॥੨੯॥
1414.t: banizadhash zubaa raa b phurasat kasoodh ||29||
1414.e: Opened her mouth, and narrated (her story) very gently.(29)

1414.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਤੁਰਾ ਮਨ ਬਸ ਆਜ਼ੁਰਗਦਹਅਮ ॥
1414.t: b dheedhan turaa man bas aazuragadhaham ||
1414.e: (Shiva said), ‘I am much afflicted on seeing you.

1414.g: ਬਿਗੋਈ ਤੁ ਹਰ ਚੀਜ਼ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦਹਅਮ ॥੩੦॥
1414.t: bigoiee ta har cheez bakhhasheedhaham ||30||
1414.e: ‘Whatever you desire I will grant you.’(30)

1414.g: ਬ ਹੰਗਾਮ ਪੀਰੀ ਜਵਾ ਮੇ ਸ਼ਵਮ ॥
1414.t: b ha(n)gaam peeree javaa me shavam ||
1414.e: (She said), ‘I should get out of the old age and become young again,

1414.g: ਬ ਮੁਲਕੇ ਹੁਮਾ ਯਾਰ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਵਮ ॥੩੧॥
1414.t: b mulake humaa yaar man meravam ||31||
1414.e: ‘So that I can go to the country of my lover.‘(31)

1414.g: ਬਦਾਸ਼ਨ ਤੁ ਦਾਨੀ ਵਗਰ ਈਂ ਵਫ਼ਾ ॥
1414.t: badhaashan ta dhaanee vagar iee(n) vaphaa ||
1414.e: (Shiva said), ‘If you think this appropriate according to your intelligence (then I will grant you the boon),

1414.g: ਬਯਾਦ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ਬਦਤਰ ਈਂ ਬੇਵਫ਼ਾ ॥੩੨॥
1414.t: bayaadh aamadhash badhatar iee(n) bevaphaa ||32||
1414.e: ‘Although it may have come in your mind very menially.’(32)

1414.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਜਾ ਬਿਆਮਦ ਬਗਿਰਦੇ ਚੁਚਾਹ ॥
1414.t: vazaa jaa biaamadh bagiradhe chuchaeh ||
1414.e: After receiving the boon, she came to the well,

1414.g: ਕਜ਼ਾ ਜਾ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਬੂਦ ਨਖ਼ਜ਼ੀਰ ਗਾਹ ॥੩੩॥
1414.t: kazaa jaa azo boodh nakhhazeer gaeh ||33||
1414.e: Where her lover used to come for hunting.(33)

1414.g: ਬਸੈਰੇ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਆਮਦ ਸ਼ਿਕਾਰ ॥
1414.t: basaire dhig(h)r roz aamadh shikaar ||
1414.e: Next day she came across the hunter,

1414.g: ਚੁ ਮਿਨ ਕਾਲ ਅਜ਼ ਬਾਸ਼ਹੇ ਨੌ ਬਹਾਰ ॥੩੪॥
1414.t: ch min kaal az baashahe nau bahaar ||34||
1414.e: Who had sharp features like the sparrow-hawk in the spring.(34)

1414.g: ਕਿ ਬਰਖ਼ਾਸਤ ਪੇਸ਼ਸ਼ ਗਵਜ਼ਨੇ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1414.t: k barakhhaasat peshash gavazane azeem ||
1414.e: On seeing him, she started to run forward like a wild cow.

1414.g: ਰਵਾ ਕਰਦ ਅਸਪਸ਼ ਚੁ ਬਾਦੇ ਨਸੀਮ ॥੩੫॥
1414.t: ravaa karadh asapash ch baadhe naseem ||35||
1414.e: And he galloped his horse at the speed of an arrow.(35)

1414.g: ਬਸੇ ਦੂਰ ਗਸ਼ਤਸ਼ ਨ ਮਾਦਹ ਦਿਗਰ ॥
1414.t: base dhoor gashatash na maadheh dhigar ||
1414.e: They went quite far,

1414.g: ਨ ਆਬੋ ਨ ਤੋਸਹ ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਖ਼ਬਰ ॥੩੬॥
1414.t: n aabo na toseh na az khhudh khhabar ||36||
1414.e: Where there was no water and no food, and they were lost in themselves.(36)

1414.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਓ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਬਾ ਤਨੇ ਨੌਜਵਾ ॥
1414.t: vazaa o shavadh baa tane nauajavaa ||
1414.e: She proceeded and bodily joined that young-man,

1414.g: ਨ ਹੂਰੋ ਪਰੀ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਜਹਾ ॥੩੭॥
1414.t: n hooro paree aaphataabe jahaa ||37||
1414.e: As there was none other like him, neither soul nor body.(37)

1414.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਵਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਆਸ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1414.t: b dheedhan vazaa shaeh aashuphateh gashat ||
1414.e: Immediately on her sight, he had fallen in love with her,

1414.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਰਫ਼ਤ ਵ ਅਜ਼ ਹੋਸ਼ ਦਸਤ ॥੩੮॥
1414.t: k az khhudh khhabar raphat v az hosh dhasat ||38||
1414.e: And lost his senses and consciousness (by meeting her).(38)

1414.g: ਕਿ ਕਸਮੇ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ਮਨ ਤੁਰਾ ਮੇ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1414.t: k kasame khhudhaa man turaa me kunam ||
1414.e: (He said,) ‘I swear by God that I must do (make love) with you,

1414.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਜਾਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁ ਬਰਤਰ ਕੁਨਮ ॥੩੯॥
1414.t: k az jaan jaanee ta baratar kunam ||39||
1414.e: ‘Because I cherish you more than my own life.’(39)

1414.g: ਉਜ਼ਰ ਕਰਦਉ ਚੂੰ ਦੁ ਸੇ ਚਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
1414.t: auzar karadhau choo(n) dh se chaar baar ||
1414.e: The woman, just to show off, refused a few times,

1414.g: ਹਮ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਬਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਮ ਵਜ਼ਾ ਕਰਦ ਕਾਰ ॥੪੦॥
1414.t: ham aakhhar bag(h)uphatam vazaa karadh kaar ||40||
1414.e: But, at the end she acquiesced.(40)

1414.g: ਬੁਬੀਂ ਗਰਦਸ਼ੇ ਬੇਵਫ਼ਾਈ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1414.t: bubee(n) garadhashe bevaphaiee zamaa ||
1414.e: (The Poet says,) Look at the infidelity of the world,

1414.g: ਕਿ ਖ਼ੂੰਨੇ ਸਿਤਾਦਸ਼ ਨ ਮਾਦਸ਼ ਨਿਸ਼ਾ ॥੪੧॥
1414.t: k khhoo(n)ne sitaadhash na maadhash nishaa ||41||
1414.e: Siavash (sons of the ruler) were annihilated without any vestiges.(41)

1414.g: ਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਖ਼ੁਸਰਵੋ ਜ਼ਾਮ ਜ਼ਮ ॥
1414.t: kujaa shaeh kai khhusaravo zaam zam ||
1414.e: Where have gone the Kings, Khusro and Jamshed?

1414.g: ਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਆਦਮ ਮੁਹੰਮਦ ਖ਼ਤੰਮ ॥੪੨॥
1414.t: kujaa shaeh aadham muha(n)madh khhata(n)m ||42||
1414.e: Where are Adam and Muhammad?(42)

1414.g: ਫ਼ਰੇਦੂੰ ਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਨ ਇਸਫ਼ੰਦਯਾਰ ॥
1414.t: pharedhoo(n) kujaa shaahan isapha(n)dhayaar ||
1414.e: Where have vanished the (legendary) kings, Faraid, Bahmin and Asfand?

1414.g: ਨ ਦਾਰਾਬ ਦਾਰਾ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥੪੩॥
1414.t: n dhaaraab dhaaraa dharaamadh shumaar ||43||
1414.e: Neither Darab, nor Dara are esteemed.(43)

1414.g: ਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਅਸਕੰਦਰੋ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਸ਼ਾਹ ॥
1414.t: kujaa shaeh asaka(n)dharo sher shaeh ||
1414.e: What happened to Alexander and Sher Shah?

1414.g: ਕਿ ਯਕ ਹਮ ਨ ਮਾਦ ਅਸਤ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਹ ਬ ਜਾਹ ॥੪੪॥
1414.t: k yak ham na maadh asat zi(n)dheh b jaeh ||44||
1414.e: None of them has survived.(44)

1414.g: ਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਤੈਮੂਰ ਬਾਬਰ ਕੁਜਾਸਤ ॥
1414.t: kujaa shaeh taimoor baabar kujaasat ||
1414.e: How Temur Shah and Babar have dissipated?

1414.g: ਹੁਮਾਯੂੰ ਕੁਜਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਅਕਬਰ ਕੁਜਾਸਤ ॥੪੫॥
1414.t: humaayoo(n) kujaa shaeh akabar kujaasat ||45||
1414.e: Where did Hamayun and Akbar had gone?(45)

1414.g: ਬਿਦਿਹ ਸਾਕੀਯਾ ਸੁਰਖ਼ ਰੰਗੇ ਫ਼ਿਰੰਗ ॥
1414.t: bidheh saakeeyaa surakhh ra(n)ge phira(n)g ||
1414.e: (The poet says) ‘Oh! Saki. Give me the reddish wine of Europe.

1414.g: ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਆਮਦ ਮਰਾ ਵਕਤ ਜ਼ਦ ਤੇਗ਼ ਜੰਗ ॥੪੬॥
1414.t: khhush aamadh maraa vakat zadh teg(h) ja(n)g ||46||
1414.e: ‘Which I would relish when I brandish the sword during the war.(46)

1414.g: ਬ ਮਨ ਦਿਹ ਕਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਰਾ ਪਯੋਰਸ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1414.t: b man dheh k khhudh raa payoras kunam ||
1414.e: ‘Give it to me so that I could contemplate,

1414.g: ਬ ਤੇਗ਼ ਆਜ਼ਮਾਈਸ਼ ਕੋਹਸ ਕੁਨਮ ॥੪੭॥੮॥
1414.t: b teg(h) aazamaieesh kohas kunam ||47||8||
1414.e: ‘And with the sword annihilate (the evil forces).’(47)(8)

1414.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਤਹ ॥
1414.t: ikOankaar vaahaguroo jee kee phateh ||
1414.e: Glory to God

1414.g: ਕਮਾਲਸ਼ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਆਜ਼ਮ ਕਰੀਮ ॥
1414.t: kamaalash karaamaat aazam kareem ||
1414.e: He is absolute, divine, eminent, and compassionate.

1414.g: ਰਜ਼ਾ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਰਾਜ਼ਕ ਰਹਾਕੋ ਰਹੀਮ ॥੧॥
1414.t: razaa bakhhash raazak rahaako raheem ||1||
1414.e: The destiny-prevailer, the sustainer, the eliminator of bondage and considerate.(1)

1414.g: ਬ ਜਾਕਰ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਈਂ ਜ਼ਮੀਨੋ ਜ਼ਮਾਨ ॥
1414.t: b jaakar dhiha(n)dh iee(n) zameeno zamaan ||
1414.e: To the devotees, He has endowed the earth, the sky.

1414.g: ਮਲੂਕੋ ਮਲਾਯਕ ਹਮਹ ਆਂ ਜਹਾਨ ॥੨॥
1414.t: malooko malaayak hameh aa(n) jahaan ||2||
1414.e: The temporal world and the heavens.(2)

1415.g: ਹਿਕਾਯਤ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦੇਮ ਸ਼ਾਹੇ ਫ਼ਿਰੰਗ ॥
1415.t: hikaayat shuneedhem shaahe phira(n)g ||
1415.e: Now listen to the tale of a foreign emperor,

1415.g: ਚੁ ਬਾ ਜ਼ਨਿ ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤੰਦ ਪੁਸ਼ਤੇ ਪਲੰਗ ॥੩॥
1415.t: ch baa zan nishasata(n)dh pushate pala(n)g ||3||
1415.e: Who was sitting on the bedstead besides his wife.(3)

1415.g: ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰਦ ਬਰ ਬੱਚਹ ਗੌਹਰ ਨਿਗ਼ਾਰ ॥
1415.t: nazar karadh bar ba'cheh gauahar nig(h)aar ||
1415.e: She looked out and saw the son of a jeweller,

1415.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਹੁਮਾਯੂੰ ਜਵਾ ਉਸਤਵਾਰ ॥੪॥
1415.t: b dheedhan humaayoo(n) javaa usatavaar ||4||
1415.e: Who appeared to be very handsome and at the prime of his youth.(4)

1415.g: ਬ ਵਕਤੇ ਸ਼ਬ ਓ ਰਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1415.t: b vakate shab o raa bukhhaadha(n)dh pesh ||
1415.e: When the sun had set she summoned,

1415.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਹੁਮਾਯੂੰ ਬ ਬਾਲਾਇ ਬੇਸ਼ ॥੫॥
1415.t: b dheedhan humaayoo(n) b baalai besh ||5||
1415.e: The handsome boy, who was tall like a cypress tree.(5)

1415.g: ਬਿਆਵੇਖ਼ਤ ਬਾ ਓ ਹਮਹ ਯਕ ਦਿਗਰ ॥
1415.t: biaavekhhat baa o hameh yak dhigar ||

1415.g: ਕਿ ਜ਼ਾਹਰ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਹੋਸ਼ ਹੈਬਤ ਹੁਨਰ ॥੬॥
1415.t: k zaahar shavadh hosh haibat hunar ||6||

1415.g: ਯਕੇ ਮੂਇ ਚੀਂ ਰਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1415.t: yake mooi chee(n) raa bukhhaadha(n)dh pesh ||
1415.e: They both (met,) embraced each other and blended into one,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਮੂਇ ਚੀਨੀ ਬਰਾਵੁਰਦ ਰੇਸ਼ ॥੭॥
1415.t: k az mooi cheenee baraavuradh resh ||7||
1415.e: All their senses, uniqueness and attributes.(7)

1415.g: ਬਰੋ ਹਰਕਿ ਬੀਨਦ ਨ ਦਾਨਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1415.t: baro harak beenadh na dhaanadh sukhhan ||
1415.e: Any body who would see him, could not judge the reality,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਰੋਇ ਮਰਦੇ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਸ਼ਕਲ ਜ਼ਨ ॥੮॥
1415.t: k az roi maradhe shudheh shakal zan ||8||
1415.e: As his male face had been disguised as female.(8)

1415.g: ਬਿਦਾਨੰਦ ਹਰਕਸ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਹਮ ਜ਼ਨ ਅਸਤ ॥
1415.t: bidhaana(n)dh harakas k iee(n) ham zan asat ||
1415.e: Every body conceded that he was a lady,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਦਰ ਪੈਕਰੇ ਚੂੰ ਪਰੀ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਅਸਤ ॥੯॥
1415.t: k dhar paikare choo(n) paree rauashan asat ||9||
1415.e: And she was as pretty as the heavenly fairies.(9)

1415.g: ਬ ਦੀਦੰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਯਕੇ ਰੋਜ਼ ਸ਼ਾਹ ॥
1415.t: b dheedha(n)dh o raa yake roz shaeh ||
1415.e: One day the king saw her (him),

1415.g: ਕਿ ਮਕਬੂਲ ਸੂਰਤ ਚੁ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਹ ਮਾਹ ॥੧੦॥
1415.t: k makabool soorat ch rakhhashi(n)dheh maeh ||10||
1415.e: And complimented that her (his) features were enchanting like the moon in the sky.(10)

1415.g: ਬਿ ਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਕਿ ਏ ਨੇਕ ਬਖ਼ਤ ॥
1415.t: b purasheedh o raa k e nek bakhhat ||
1415.e: She (he) was, then, counselled, ‘You the lucky one,

1415.g: ਸਜ਼ਾਵਾਰ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਅਸਤੁ ਸ਼ਾਯਾਨ ਤਖ਼ਤ ॥੧੧॥
1415.t: sazaavaar shaeh asat shaayaan takhhat ||11||
1415.e: ‘You are worthy of a king and fit to sit on the throne.’(11)

1415.g: ਕਿ ਜ਼ਨ ਤੋ ਕਦਾਮੀ ਕਿਰਾ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰੀ ॥
1415.t: k zan to kadhaamee kiraa dhukhhataree ||
1415.e: ‘Whose woman are you and whose daughter are you?

1415.g: ਕਿ ਮੁਲਕੇ ਕਿਰਾ ਰੋ ਕਿਰਾ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਹਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
1415.t: k mulake kiraa ro kiraa khhavaiaaharee ||12||
1415.e: ‘Which country you belong to and whose sister are you?(12)

1415.g: ਬ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਬਹਰਮੰਦ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ॥
1415.t: b nazar a(n)dharoo(n) baharama(n)dh aamadhash ||
1415.e: ‘You have penetrated the inner vision,

1415.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਸ਼ਹੇ ਦਿਲ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ॥੧੩॥
1415.t: b dheedhan shahe dhil pasa(n)dh aamadhash ||13||
1415.e: ‘And has the king fallen for you at the first sight.’(13)

1415.g: ਕਨੀਜ਼ਕ ਯਕੇ ਰਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1415.t: kaneezak yake raa bukhhaadha(n)dh pesh ||
1415.e: Through his maid, the king called her (him),

1415.g: ਸ਼ਬੰ ਗਾਹਿ ਬੁਰਦਸ਼ ਦਰੂੰ ਖ਼ਾਨਹ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ॥੧੪॥
1415.t: shaba(n) gaeh buradhash dharoo(n) khhaaneh khhesh ||14||
1415.e: And asked her to bring her (him) to the inner chambers of his house.(14)

1415.g: ਬਿਗੁਫ਼ਤਾ ਕਿ ਏ ਸਰਵ ਕਦ ਸੀਮ ਤਨ ॥
1415.t: biguphataa k e sarav kadh seem tan ||
1415.e: (The king had said,) ‘Oh, my maid, I have come across an elegant like a cypress tree,

1415.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ੇ ਫ਼ਲਕ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਨ ॥੧੫॥
1415.t: charaag(h)e phalak aaphataabe yaman ||15||
1415.e: ‘Which looks like the moon fallen from the skies of Yaman.(15)

1415.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਬਹਰ ਮਾ ਰਾ ਬ ਤਪਸ਼ੀਦ ਦਿਲ ॥
1415.t: vazaa bahar maa raa b tapasheedh dhil ||
1415.e: ‘My heart is writhing for her,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਮਾਹੀ ਬਿਅਫ਼ਤਾਦ ਅਜ਼ ਆਬ ਗਿਲ ॥੧੬॥
1415.t: k maahee biaphataadh az aab gil ||16||
1415.e: ‘It is like fish flutters when it is thrown in a dirty puddle.(16)

1415.g: ਬੁਰੋਏ ਸ਼ਬਾ ਪੈਕ ਗੁਲਜ਼ਾਰ ਮਾ ॥
1415.t: buroe shabaa paik gulazaar maa ||
1415.e: ‘Oh, you my maid-messenger, who are like a blooming flower,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਦਰ ਪੇਸ਼ ਯਾਰੇ ਵਫ਼ਾਦਾਰ ਮਾ ॥੧੭॥
1415.t: k dhar pesh yaare vaphaadhaar maa ||17||
1415.e: ‘Go to the blossoming bud and bring her to me.(17)

1415.g: ਤੁ ਗ਼ਰ ਪੇਸ਼ ਓ ਰਾ ਬਿਯਾਰੀ ਮਰਾ ॥
1415.t: t g(h)r pesh o raa biyaaree maraa ||
1415.e: ‘If you bring her to me for me,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇਮ ਸਰਬਸਤਹ ਗੰਜੇ ਤੁਰਾ ॥੧੮॥
1415.t: k bakhhashem sarabasateh ga(n)je turaa ||18||
1415.e: ‘I will open up all the annuls of my treasures for you.’(18)

1415.g: ਰਵਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਕਨੀਜ਼ਕ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1415.t: ravaa shudh kaneezak shuneedh iee(n) sukhhan ||
1415.e: Harking to this the maidservant instantly departed,

1415.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਸਰ ਤਾਬ ਬੁਨ ॥੧੯॥
1415.t: bigoyadh sukhhan raa z sar taab bun ||19||
1415.e: And narrated from head to tail of the whole conservation.(19)

1415.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾਨੀ ਕਨੀਜ਼ਕ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦੀਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1415.t: zubaanee kaneezak shuneedhee(n) sukhhan ||
1415.e: When she (he) listened to the whole talk from the maid,

1415.g: ਬ ਪੇਚੀਦ ਬਰ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਪੋਸ਼ਾਕ ਜ਼ਨ ॥੨੦॥
1415.t: b pecheedh bar khhudh z poshaak zan ||20||
1415.e: Feeling topsy-turvy, he was overpowered with distress.(20)

1415.g: ਕਿ ਜ਼ਾਹਰ ਕੁਨਾਨੀਦ ਅਸਬਾਬ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ॥
1415.t: k zaahar kunaaneedh asabaab khhesh ||
1415.e: (And thought,) ‘If I reveal my secret to the world,

1415.g: ਕਿ ਦੀਦਨ ਜਹਾ ਰਾ ਬ ਕਿਰਦਾਰ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ॥੨੧॥
1415.t: k dheedhan jahaa raa b kiradhaar khhesh ||21||
1415.e: ‘All my planning will be dismantled.(21)

1415.g: ਬਖ਼ਾਹਦ ਮਰਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਏ ਯਾਰ ਮਾ ॥
1415.t: bakhhaahadh maraa shaeh e yaar maa ||
1415.e: ‘Looking at my female attire, the king has fallen for me,

1415.g: ਮਰਾ ਮਸਲਿਹਤ ਦਿਹ ਵਫ਼ਾਦਾਰ ਮਾ ॥੨੨॥
1415.t: maraa masalihat dheh vaphaadhaar maa ||22||
1415.e: ‘Oh, my lady, please counsel me what to do?’(22)

1415.g: ਤੁ ਗੋਈ ਮਨਈਂ ਜਾ ਗੁਰੇਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਵਮ ॥
1415.t: t goiee maniee(n) jaa gurezaa shavam ||
1415.e: ‘If you say so, I will run away from this place.

1415.g: ਕਿ ਇਮ ਰੋਜ਼ ਅਜ਼ ਜਾਇ ਖ਼ੇਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਵਮ ॥੨੩॥
1415.t: k im roz az jai khhezaa shavam ||23||
1415.e: ‘Immediately, today, I take on my heels.’(23)

1415.g: ਨ ਤਰਸੀ ਇਲਾਜੇ ਤੁਰਾ ਮਨ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1415.t: n tarasee ilaaje turaa man kunam ||
1415.e: (The Queen said,) ‘Don’t be afraid, I will tell you the remedy.

1415.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਵਜ਼ਾ ਚਾਰ ਮਾਹੇ ਨਿਹਮ ॥੨੪॥
1415.t: b dheedhan vazaa chaar maahe niham ||24||
1415.e: ‘Even remaining under his observation, I will keep you for four months.’(24)

1415.g: ਚੁ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਪੀਦ ਯਕ ਜਾਇ ਚੂੰ ਬੇ ਖ਼ਬਰ ॥
1415.t: ch khhushapeedh yak jai choo(n) be khhabar ||
1415.e: Then, they both went to the sleeping-place and went into a slumber,

1415.g: ਖ਼ਬਰ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਓ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਨਰ ॥੨੫॥
1415.t: khhabar gashat shudh shaeh o sher nar ||25||
1415.e: And the news roamed around to the lion hearted king.(25)

1415.g: ਦਹਾਨੇ ਕਨੀਜ਼ਕ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ॥
1415.t: dhahaane kaneezak shuneedh iee(n) sukhhan ||
1415.e: The maid, then, conveyed the king what was happening,

1415.g: ਬਜੁੰਬਸ਼ ਬਲਰਜ਼ੀਦ ਸਰ ਤਾਬ ਬੁਨ ॥੨੬॥
1415.t: baju(n)bash balarazeedh sar taab bun ||26||
1415.e: And the king flew into rage from head to feet.(26)

1416.g: ਬਿਯਾਮਦ ਕਜ਼ੋ ਜਾਇ ਓ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਦੀਦ ॥
1416.t: biyaamadh kazo jai o khhuphateh dheedh ||
1416.e: Instantly he came to the palace of the queen,

1416.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਸਰਤਾ ਕਦਮ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਮਿਹਰਸ਼ ਤਪੀਦ ॥੨੭॥
1416.t: z sarataa kadham ham ch miharash tapeedh ||27||
1416.e: And seeing them in the same bed, became inflammable like the sun.(27)

1416.g: ਬਿਦਾਨਦ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਰਾ ਖ਼ਬਰਦਾਰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥
1416.t: bidhaanadh k iee(n) raa khhabaradhaar shudh ||
1416.e: The king assumed that she had discerned his intentions,

1416.g: ਬ ਰੋਜ਼ੇ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਈਂ ਖ਼ਬਰਦਾਰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥੨੮॥
1416.t: b roze azaa iee(n) khhabaradhaar shudh ||28||
1416.e: And had become very cautious.(28)

1416.g: ਬਿਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਪੀਦ ਯਕ ਜਾ ਯਕੇ ਖ਼ਾਬ ਗਾਹ ॥
1416.t: bikhhushapeedh yak jaa yake khhaab gaeh ||
1416.e: That is why they went into sleep at the same place and in the same bed.

1416.g: ਮਰਾ ਦਾਵ ਅਫ਼ਤਦ ਨ ਯਜ਼ਦਾ ਗਵਾਹ ॥੨੯॥
1416.t: maraa dhaav aphatadh na yazadhaa gavaeh ||29||
1416.e: ‘God forbid, she made my attempt impossible.(29)

1416.g: ਜੁਦਾਗਰ ਬੁਬੀਂਨਮ ਅਜ਼ ਈਂ ਖ਼ਾਬ ਗਾਹ ॥
1416.t: judhaagar bubee(n)nam az iee(n) khhaab gaeh ||
1416.e: ‘If I had found her alone in the bedroom,

1416.g: ਯਕੇ ਜੁਫ਼ਤ ਬਾਸ਼ਮ ਚੁ ਖ਼ੁਰਸ਼ੈਦ ਮਾਹ ॥੩੦॥
1416.t: yake juphat baasham ch khhurashaidh maeh ||30||
1416.e: ‘I would have at once clung to her as the moon merged into the sun.’(30)

1416.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਰੋਜ਼ ਗਸ਼ਤਹ ਬਿਯਾਮਦ ਦਿਗਰ ॥
1416.t: vazaa roz gashateh biyaamadh dhigar ||
1416.e: The king returned that night lamenting,

1416.g: ਹੁਮਾ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਦੀਦੰ ਯਕੇ ਜਾ ਬਬਰ ॥੩੧॥
1416.t: humaa khhuphateh dheedha(n) yake jaa babar ||31||
1416.e: And the second day again he saw them sleeping in the same style.(31)

1416.g: ਦਰੇਗ਼ਾ ਅਜ਼ੀਂ ਗਰ ਜੁਦਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਮ ॥
1416.t: dhareg(h)aa azee(n) gar judhaa yaaphatam ||
1416.e: ‘Had I found her sleeping alone,

1416.g: ਯਕੇ ਹਮਲਹ ਚੂੰ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਨਰ ਸਾਖ਼ਤਮ ॥੩੨॥
1416.t: yake hamaleh choo(n) sher nar saakhhatam ||32||
1416.e: ‘I would have pounced upon her like a lion.’(32)

1416.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਰਫ਼ਤਸ਼ ਸਿਯਮ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ॥
1416.t: dhig(h)r roz raphatash siyam aamadhash ||
1416.e: He went away on the second day and again appeared on the third day.

1416.g: ਬ ਦੀਦੰਦ ਯਕ ਜਾਇ ਬਰ ਤਾਫ਼ਤਸ਼ ॥੩੩॥
1416.t: b dheedha(n)dh yak jai bar taaphatash ||33||
1416.e: As usual, seeing them together he departed.(33)

1416.g: ਬ ਰੋਜ਼ੇ ਚੁ ਆਮਦ ਬ ਦੀਦੰਦ ਜੁਫ਼ਤ ॥
1416.t: b roze ch aamadh b dheedha(n)dh juphat ||
1416.e: On the fourth day they were joined together again.

1416.g: ਬ ਹੈਰਤ ਫ਼ਰੋ ਰਫ਼ਤ ਬਾ ਦਿਲ ਬਿਗੁਫ਼ਤ ॥੩੪॥
1416.t: b hairat pharo raphat baa dhil biguphat ||34||
1416.e: He hung his head in astonishment and thought,(34)

1416.g: ਕਿ ਹੈਫ਼ ਅਸਤ ਆਂ ਰਾ ਜੁਦਾ ਯਾਫ਼ਤਮ ॥
1416.t: k haiph asat aa(n) raa judhaa yaaphatam ||
1416.e: ‘Alas, if I had found her alone,

1416.g: ਕਿ ਤੀਰੇ ਕਮਾ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਸਾਖ਼ਤਮ ॥੩੫॥
1416.t: k teere kamaa a(n)dharoo(n) saakhhatam ||35||
1416.e: ‘I would have easily fixed arrow into her bow.’(35)

1416.g: ਨ ਦੀਦੇਮ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਨ ਦੋਜ਼ਨ ਬਤੀਰ ॥
1416.t: n dheedhem dhushaman na dhozan bateer ||
1416.e: ‘Neither I got hold of the enemy, nor could I pierce an arrow,

1416.g: ਨ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਮ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਨ ਕਰਦਮ ਅਸੀਰ ॥੩੬॥
1416.t: n kushatam adhooraa na karadham aseer ||36||
1416.e: ‘Neither I killed the enemy nor I captivated him.’(36)

1416.g: ਸ਼ਸ਼ਮ ਰੋਜ਼ ਆਮਦ ਬ ਦੀਦਹ ਵਜ਼ਾ ॥
1416.t: shasham roz aamadh b dheedheh vazaa ||
1416.e: On the sixth day when he came he saw her sleeping with the queen in the similar manner.

1416.g: ਬ ਪੇਚਸ਼ ਦਰਾਵਖ਼ਤ ਗੁਫ਼ਤ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥੩੭॥
1416.t: b pechash dharaavakhhat guphat az zubaa ||37||
1416.e: He was extremely up set and said to himself,(37)

1416.g: ਨ ਦੀਦੇਮ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਕਿ ਰੇਜ਼ੇਮ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥
1416.t: n dheedhem dhushaman k rezem khhoo(n) ||
1416.e: ‘If I don’t see my enemy, I won’t make him to shed his blood.

1416.g: ਦਰੇਗਾ ਨ ਕੈਬਰ ਕਮਾ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ॥੩੮॥
1416.t: dharegaa na kaibar kamaa a(n)dharoo(n) ||38||
1416.e: ‘Alas, I cannot keep my arrow contained in my bow.(38)

1416.g: ਦਰੇਗ਼ਾ ਬ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਨ ਆਵੇਖ਼ਤਮ ॥
1416.t: dhareg(h)aa b dhushaman na aavekhhatam ||
1416.e: ‘And alas, I could not embrace the foe,

1416.g: ਦਰੇਗਾ ਨਾ ਬਾ ਯਕ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਰੇਖ਼ਤਮ ॥੩੯॥
1416.t: dharegaa naa baa yak dhig(h)r rekhhatam ||39||
1416.e: ‘And neither could we copulate each other.’(39)

1416.g: ਹਕੀਕਤ ਸ਼ਨਾਸ਼ਦ ਨ ਹਾਲੇ ਦਿਗਰ ॥
1416.t: hakeekat shanaashadh na haale dhigar ||
1416.e: Blind in love he did not try to acquiesce the reality.

1416.g: ਕਿ ਮਾਯਲ ਬਸੇ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਓ ਤਾਬ ਸਰ ॥੪੦॥
1416.t: k maayal base gashat o taab sar ||40||
1416.e: Neither, in excitement, he cared to learn the truth.(40)

1416.g: ਬੁਬੀਂ ਬੇਖ਼ਬਰ ਰਾ ਚਕਾਰੇ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1416.t: bubee(n) bekhhabar raa chakaare kunadh ||
1416.e: Look, unaware what this king was doing,

1416.g: ਕਿ ਕਾਰੇ ਬਦਸ਼ ਇਖ਼ਤਯਾਰੇ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੪੧॥
1416.t: k kaare badhash ikhhatayaare kunadh ||41||
1416.e: And was scheming to revel in such vices.(41)

1416.g: ਬੁਬੀਂ ਬੇ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਬਦ ਖ਼ਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥
1416.t: bubee(n) be khhabar badh khharaashee kunadh ||
1416.e: Look, an ignorant scratches his head,

1416.g: ਕਿ ਬੇਆਬ ਸਰ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਤਰਾਸ਼ੀ ਕੁਨਦ ॥੪੨॥
1416.t: k beaab sar khhudh taraashee kunadh ||42||
1416.e: And without wetting it, he shaves it.(42)

1416.g: ਬਿਦਿਹ ਸਾਕੀਯਾ ਜਾਮ ਸਬਜ਼ੇ ਮਰਾ ॥
1416.t: bidheh saakeeyaa jaam sabaze maraa ||
1416.e: (The poet says,) ‘Oh the Saki, give me my green cup,

1416.g: ਕਿ ਸਰਬਸਤਹ ਮਨ ਗੰਜ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਮ ਤੁਰਾ ॥੪੩॥
1416.t: k sarabasateh man ga(n)j bakhhasham turaa ||43||
1416.e: ‘So that without any infringement, I get the understanding.(43)

1416.g: ਬਿਦਿਹ ਸਾਕੀਯਾ੧ ਸਾਗ਼ਰੇ ਸਬਜ਼ ਫ਼ਾਮ ॥
1416.t: bidheh saakeeyaa1 saag(h)re sabaz phaam ||
1416.e: ‘And give me the cup full of green (liquid),

1416.g: ਕਿ ਖ਼ਸਮ ਅਫ਼ਕਨੋ ਵਕਤਹ ਸਤਸ਼ ਬ ਕਾਮ ॥੪੪॥੯॥
1416.t: k khhasam aphakano vakateh satash b kaam ||44||9||
1416.e: ‘Which helps to destroy the enemies.(44)(9)

1416.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਤਹ ॥
1416.t: ikOankaar vaahaguroo jee kee phateh ||
1416.e: Glory to God

1416.g: ਗ਼ਫ਼ੂਰੋ ਗ਼ੁਨਹ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ਗ਼ਾਫ਼ਲ ਕੁਸ਼ ਅਸਤ ॥
1416.t: g(h)phooro g(h)uneh bakhhash g(h)aaphal kush asat ||
1416.e: You are the benevolent, pardoner of sins, and destroyer,

1416.g: ਜਹਾ ਰਾ ਤੁਈਂ ਬਸਤੁ ਈਂ ਬੰਦੁਬਸਤ ॥੧॥
1416.t: jahaa raa tuiee(n) basat iee(n) ba(n)dhubasat ||1||
1416.e: Whatever is there in the universe, is all your creation.(1)

1416.g: ਨ ਪਿਸਰੋ ਨ ਮਾਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਦਰ ਪਿਦਰ ॥
1416.t: n pisaro na maadhar biraadhar pidhar ||
1416.e: Neither you favour sons, nor brothers,

1416.g: ਨ ਦਾਮਾਦੁ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਨ ਯਾਰੇ ਦਿਗਰ ॥੨॥
1416.t: n dhaamaadh dhushaman na yaare dhigar ||2||
1416.e: Neither son-in-laws, nor enemies, nor friends,(2)

1416.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦਮ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਮਾਯੰਦਰਾ ॥
1416.t: shuneedham sukhhan shaeh maaya(n)dharaa ||
1416.e: Listen to the tale of the King of Mayindra,

1416.g: ਕਿ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਦਿਲੋ ਨਾਮ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥੩॥
1416.t: k rauashan dhilo naam rauashan zamaa ||3||
1416.e: Who was knowledgeable and was renown all over the world.(3)

1416.g: ਕਿ ਨਾਮਸ਼ ਵਜ਼ੀਰਸਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸ਼ਊਰ ॥
1416.t: k naamash vazeerasat saahib shuoor ||
1416.e: He had a very intelligent person as his minister.

1416.g: ਕਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਿਮਾਗ਼ ਅਸਤ ਜ਼ਾਹਰ ਜ਼ਹੂਰ ॥੪॥
1416.t: k saahib dhimaag(h) asat zaahar zahoor ||4||
1416.e: Who was very shrewd and impressive.(4)

1416.g: ਕਿ ਪਿਸਰੇ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਬੂਦ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਜ਼ਮੀਰ ॥
1416.t: k pisare azaa boodh rauashan zameer ||
1416.e: He (the Minister?) was blessed with a son, whose thinking was logical too,

1416.g: ਕਿ ਹੁਸਨਲ ਜਮਾਲ ਅਸਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਅਮੀਰ ॥੫॥
1416.t: k husanal jamaal asat saahib ameer ||5||
1416.e: Not only handsome, (his son) possessed brilliant qualities.(5)

1416.g: ਕਿ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਦਿਲੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਓ ਨਾਮ ਬੂਦ ॥
1416.t: k rauashan dhile shaeh o naam boodh ||
1416.e: He was known as a person with courageous heart,

1417.g: ਅਦੂਰਾ ਜ਼ਿਮਰਦੀ ਬਰ ਆਵੁਰਦ ਦੂਦ ॥੬॥
1417.t: adhooraa zimaradhee bar aavuradh dhoodh ||6||
1417.e: Through his manliness, he had blown up the enemies.(6)

1417.g: ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ਯਕੇ ਬੂਦ ਓ ਹੋਸ਼ਮੰਦ ॥
1417.t: vazeer yake boodh o hoshama(n)dh ||
1417.e: (Another) one of the King's ministers was very shrewd,

1417.g: ਰਈਯਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ ਅਸਤ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਗਜ਼ੰਦ ॥੭॥
1417.t: rieeyat nivaaz asat dhushaman gaza(n)dh ||7||
1417.e: Who inspired the subject but perpetrated the enemies.(7)

1417.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰੇ ਹਸਤ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਚਰਾਗ਼ ॥
1417.t: vazaa dhukhhatare hasat rauashan charaag(h) ||
1417.e: That minister had a daughter, who was as illuminated as light,

1417.g: ਕਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਬੂਦ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਦਿਮਾਗ਼ ॥੮॥
1417.t: k naame azaa boodh rauashan dhimaag(h) ||8||
1417.e: And her name was named 'Roshan Dimaagh' (lit. Enlightened Intellect).(8)

1417.g: ਬ ਮਕਤਬ ਸਪੁਰਦੰਦ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਤਿਫ਼ਲ ॥
1417.t: b makatab sapuradha(n)dh har dho tiphal ||
1417.e: The King admitted two of his children,

1417.g: ਕਿ ਤਿਫ਼ਲਸ਼ ਬਸੇ ਰੋਜ਼ ਗਸ਼ਤੰਦ ਖ਼ਿਜ਼ਲ ॥੯॥
1417.t: k tiphalash base roz gashata(n)dh khhizal ||9||
1417.e: Who had been sauntering too long, in school.(9)

1417.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤੰਦ ਦਾਨਾਇ ਮੌਲਾਇ ਰੂਮ ॥
1417.t: nishasata(n)dh dhaanai maualai room ||
1417.e: They were admitted with a wise Maulana (religious priest) of Rome,

1417.g: ਕਿ ਦਿਰਮਸ਼ ਬਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਆਂ ਮਰਜ਼ ਬੂਮ ॥੧੦॥
1417.t: k dhiramash babakhhasheedh aa(n) maraz boom ||10||
1417.e: Who had been endowed with wealth and land.(10)

1417.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤੰਦ ਦਰ ਆਂ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਫ਼ਲੇ ਬਸੇ ॥
1417.t: nishasata(n)dh dhar aa(n) jai tiphale base ||
1417.e: Other children were present there too,

1417.g: ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੇ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਅਜ਼ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਹਰ ਕਸੇ ॥੧੧॥
1417.t: bukhhaadhe sukhhan az kitaab har kase ||11||
1417.e: Who used to read their lessons from the books.(11)

1417.g: ਬ ਬਗ਼ਲ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਰੰਦ ਹਰ ਯਕ ਕਿਤਾਬ ॥
1417.t: b bag(h)l a(n)dhar aara(n)dh har yak kitaab ||
1417.e: They all would bring their books tucked under their arms,

1417.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤਉਰੇਤ ਅੰਜੀਲ ਵਜਹੇ ਅਦਾਬ ॥੧੨॥
1417.t: z tauret a(n)jeel vajahe adhaab ||12||
1417.e: Often there were discussions on Tohra and Anjeel.(12)

1417.g: ਦੁ ਮਕਤਬ ਕੁਨਾਨੀਦ ਹਫ਼ਤ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1417.t: dh makatab kunaaneedh haphat az zubaa ||
1417.e: For the teaching of seven languages, two schools were established.

1417.g: ਯਕੇ ਮਰਦ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਦੀਗਰ ਜ਼ਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
1417.t: yake maradh bukhhaadha(n)dh dheegar zanaa ||13||
1417.e: One for the males; the other for the females.(13)

1417.g: ਕਿ ਤਿਫ਼ਲਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਮੁਲਾ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਸ਼ ॥
1417.t: k tiphalaa bukhhaadha(n)dh mulaa khhushash ||
1417.e: The boys were taught by a Maulana, (A male Islamic scholar),

1417.g: ਜ਼ਨਾਰਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਜ਼ਨੇ ਫ਼ਾਜ਼ਲਸ਼ ॥੧੪॥
1417.t: zanaaraa bukhhaadha(n)dh zane phaazalash ||14||
1417.e: A knowledgeable lady instructed the girls.(14)

1417.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਦਰਮਿਯਾ ਬੂਦ ਦੀਵਾਰ ਜ਼ੀਂ ॥
1417.t: vazaa dharamiyaa boodh dheevaar zee(n) ||
1417.e: A wall was built between the two sections,

1417.g: ਯਕੇ ਆਂ ਤਰਫ਼ ਬੂਦ ਯਕੇ ਤਰਫ਼ ਈਂ ॥੧੫॥
1417.t: yake aa(n) taraph boodh yake taraph iee(n) ||15||
1417.e: The boys were kept on the one side and girls on the other.(15)

1417.g: ਸਬਕ ਬੁਰਦ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਜ਼ਿ ਹਰ ਯਕ ਹੁਨਰ ॥
1417.t: sabak buradh har dho z har yak hunar ||
1417.e: Both sides were endeavouring hard,

1417.g: ਇਲਮ ਕਸ਼ਮਕਸ਼ ਕਰਦ ਬਾ ਯਕ ਦਿਗਰ ॥੧੬॥
1417.t: eilam kashamakash karadh baa yak dhigar ||16||
1417.e: To learn and excel over the other side,(16)

1417.g: ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਹਰ ਯਕੇ ਰਾਦ ਹਰ ਯਕ ਕਿਤਾਬ ॥
1417.t: sukhhan har yake raadh har yak kitaab ||
1417.e: Everyone read all the books,

1417.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਫ਼ਰਸ਼ ਅਰਬੀ ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਜਵਾਬ ॥੧੭॥
1417.t: zubaa pharash arabee bigoyadh javaab ||17||
1417.e: Which were written both in Persian and Arabic.(17)

1417.g: ਇਲਮ ਰਾ ਸੁਖਨ ਰਾਦ ਬਾ ਯਕ ਦਿਗਰ ॥
1417.t: eilam raa sukhan raadh baa yak dhigar ||
1417.e: They discussed education among themselves,

1417.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਕਾਮਲ ਜ਼ਿ ਜ਼ਾਯਲ ਜ਼ਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਸਿਯਰ ॥੧੮॥
1417.t: z kaamal z zaayal z naaradh siyar ||18||
1417.e: Irrespective of the fact whether they were intelligent or irrational.(18)

1417.g: ਕਿ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਇਲਮੋ ਅਲਮਬਰ ਕਸ਼ੀਦ ॥
1417.t: k shamasher ilamo alamabar kasheedh ||
1417.e: They raised the flags to acquire education for the swordsmanship,

1417.g: ਬਹਾਰੇ ਜਵਾਨੀ ਬ ਹਰਦੋ ਰਸ਼ੀਦ ॥੧੯॥
1417.t: bahaare javaanee b haradho rasheedh ||19||
1417.e: As soon as they reached the ages of maturity.(19)

1417.g: ਬਹਾਰਸ਼ ਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਗੁਲੇ ਦੋਸਤਾ ॥
1417.t: bahaarash dhar aamadh gule dhosataa ||
1417.e: As the spring season approached,

1417.g: ਬਜੁੰਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਸਹੇ ਚੀਸਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
1417.t: baju(n)bash dharaamadh sahe cheesataa ||20||
1417.e: In both the factions, the China syndrome sprung up.(20)

1417.g: ਬਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਸ਼ਹਿਨਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਚੀਂ ॥
1417.t: barakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh shahinashaeh chee(n) ||
1417.e: Like the King of kings of China, their desires rose,

1417.g: ਬਖ਼ੂਬੀ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਤਨੇ ਨਾਜ਼ਨੀਂ ॥੨੧॥
1417.t: bakhhoobee dharaamadh tane naazanee(n) ||21||
1417.e: Particularly, the ladies achieved the beauteous treats.(21)

1417.g: ਬ ਖ਼ੂਬੀ ਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਗੁਲੇ ਬੋਸਤਾ ॥
1417.t: b khhoobee dhar aamadh gule bosataa ||
1417.e: All of them blossomed like garden,

1417.g: ਬ ਐਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਦਿਲੇ ਦੋਸਤਾ ॥੨੨॥
1417.t: b aaish a(n)dhar aamadh dhile dhosataa ||22||
1417.e: And all the friends indulged in merriment.(22)

1417.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਦੇਵਾਰ ਜੋ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਮੂਸ ਹਸਤ ॥
1417.t: z dhevaar jo a(n)dharoo(n) moos hasat ||
1417.e: Inside that wall, a mouse used to live,

1417.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਦੇਵਾਰ ਓ ਹਮ ਚੂੰ ਸੂਰਾਖ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥੨੩॥
1417.t: z dhevaar o ham choo(n) sooraakh gashat ||23||
1417.e: Which had caused holes to appear in the wall.(23)

1417.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਤਨ ॥
1417.t: b dheedhan azaa a(n)dharoo(n) har dh tan ||
1417.e: Through them two (people) used to observe each other,

1417.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ੇ ਜਹਾ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਨ ॥੨੪॥
1417.t: charaag(h)e jahaa aaphataabe yaman ||24||
1417.e: One was the light of the universe and the other sun of the Yamanee Skies.(24)

1417.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਇਸ਼ਕ ਆਵੇਖ਼ਤ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਨਿਹਾ ॥
1417.t: chunaa ishak aavekhhat har dho nihaa ||
1417.e: Thus those two were trapped in the love affair,

1417.g: ਕਿ ਇਲਮਸ਼ ਰਵਦ ਦਸਤ ਹੋਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ ਜਹਾ ॥੨੫॥
1417.t: k ilamash ravadh dhasat hosh az jahaa ||25||
1417.e: And they neglected their education and the worldly awareness.(25)

1417.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਆਵੇਖ਼ਤ ਬਾਹਮ ਰਗ਼ੇਬ ॥
1417.t: chunaa har dh aavekhhat baaham rag(h)eb ||
1417.e: Their entanglement in the love was so intense,

1417.g: ਕਿ ਦਸਤ ਅਜ਼ ਇਨਾਰਫ਼ਤ ਪਾ ਅਜ਼ ਰਕੇਬ ॥੨੬॥
1417.t: k dhasat az inaaraphat paa az rakeb ||26||
1417.e: That both of them lost the senses of managing the stirrups of their horses.(26)

1417.g: ਬ ਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਕਿ ਏ ਨੇਕ ਖ਼ੋਇ ॥
1417.t: b purasheedh har dho k e nek khhoi ||
1417.e: They both asked each other, ‘Oh the cherished one, you are like the sun,

1417.g: ਕਿ ਏ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਜਹਾ ਮਾਹ ਰੋਇ ॥੨੭॥
1417.t: k e aaphataabe jahaa maeh roi ||27||
1417.e: ‘And you, the Enlightener of the universe, and taking after the moon, how are you?’(27)

1417.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਹਾਲ ਗੁਜ਼ਰਦ ਬ ਆਂ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਤਨ ॥
1417.t: k iee(n) haal guzaradh b aa(n) har dho tan ||
1417.e: When both of them were passing through such a state,

1417.g: ਬਿ ਪੁਰਸ਼ੀਦ ਅਖ਼ਵੰਦ ਵ ਅਖ਼ਵੰਦ ਜ਼ਨ ॥੨੮॥
1417.t: b purasheedh akhhava(n)dh v akhhava(n)dh zan ||28||
1417.e: Both, the male and female teachers, asked,(28)

1417.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ੇ ਫ਼ਲਕ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਜਹਾ ॥
1417.t: charaag(h)e phalak aaphataabe jahaa ||
1417.e: ‘O, you the lamp of the skies and the Enlightener of the universe,

1417.g: ਚਰਾ ਲਾਗਰੀ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਵਜਹੇ ਨੁਮਾ ॥੨੯॥
1417.t: charaa laagaree gashat vajahe numaa ||29||
1417.e: ‘Why do you seem to be languishing?(29)

1417.g: ਚਿ ਆਜ਼ਾਰ ਗਸ਼ਤਹ ਬੁਗੋ ਜਾਨ ਮਾ ॥
1417.t: ch aazaar gashateh bugo jaan maa ||
1417.e: ‘Tell us, our loved ones, what has distressed you?

1418.g: ਕਿ ਲਾਗ਼ਰ ਚਰਾ ਗਸ਼ਤੀ ਏ ਜਾਨ ਮਾ ॥੩੦॥
1418.t: k laag(h)r charaa gashatee e jaan maa ||30||
1418.e: Facially you look so weak?(30)

1418.g: ਅਜ਼ਾਰਸ਼ ਬੁਗੋ ਤਾ ਇਲਾਜੇ ਕੁਨਮ ॥
1418.t: azaarash bugo taa ilaaje kunam ||
1418.e: ‘Tell us about your afflictions so that we can suggest you remedies.

1418.g: ਕਿ ਮਰਜ਼ੇ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ਰਾ ਖ਼ਿਰਾਜ਼ੇ ਕੁਨਮ ॥੩੧॥
1418.t: k maraze shumaa raa khhiraaze kunam ||31||
1418.e: ‘We may be able to prescribe some medicine.’(31)

1418.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਰਾ ਨ ਦਾਦਸ਼ ਜਵਾਬ ॥
1418.t: shuneedh iee(n) sukhhan raa na dhaadhash javaab ||
1418.e: Both listened but did not try to respond,

1418.g: ਫ਼ਰੋ ਬੁਰਦ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਤਨੇ ਇਸ਼ਕ ਤਾਬ ॥੩੨॥
1418.t: pharo buradh har dho tane ishak taab ||32||
1418.e: And hung their heads under the stress of love.(32)

1418.g: ਚੁ ਗੁਜ਼ਰੀਦ ਬਰਵੈ ਦੁ ਸੇ ਚਾਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ॥
1418.t: ch guzareedh baravai dh se chaar roz ||
1418.e: When two, three or four days had lapsed,

1418.g: ਬਰਾਮਦ ਦੁ ਤਨ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਗੇਤੀ ਫ਼ਰੋਜ਼ ॥੩੩॥
1418.t: baraamadh dh tan har dho getee pharoz ||33||
1418.e: Both the bodies became conspicuous in love.(33)

1418.g: ਬਰੋ ਦੂਰ ਗਸ਼ਤੰਦ ਤਿਫ਼ਲੀ ਗ਼ੁਬਾਰ ॥
1418.t: baro dhoor gashata(n)dh tiphalee g(h)ubaar ||
1418.e: The innocent childhood emotions were decimated,

1418.g: ਕਿ ਮੁਹਰਸ਼ ਬਰ ਆਵੁਰਦ ਚੂੰ ਨੌਬਹਾਰ ॥੩੪॥
1418.t: k muharash bar aavuradh choo(n) nauabahaar ||34||
1418.e: And the new sun came out with fresh inception.(34)

1418.g: ਵਜ਼ਾ ਫ਼ਾਜ਼ਲਸ਼ ਬੂਦ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਯਕੇ ॥
1418.t: vazaa phaazalash boodh dhukhhatar yake ||
1418.e: She (the girl) was the daughter of a very genius,

1418.g: ਕਿ ਸੂਰਤ ਜਮਾਲ ਅਸਤ ਦਾਨਸ਼ ਬਸ਼ੇ ॥੩੫॥
1418.t: k soorat jamaal asat dhaanash bashe ||35||
1418.e: And she was extremely pretty and intelligent.(35)

1418.g: ਸ਼ਨਾਸੀਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਹਾਲਤ ਵਜ਼ਾ ॥
1418.t: shanaaseedh o raa z haalat vazaa ||
1418.e: He (the boy) had recognised her from her apparent condition,

1418.g: ਬਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਸ਼ ਦਰੂੰ ਖ਼ਿਲਵਤਸ਼ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥੩੬॥
1418.t: bag(h)uphatash dharoo(n) khhilavatash khhush zubaa ||36||
1418.e: He took her in seclusion and cordially said,(36)

1418.g: ਕਿ ਏ ਸਰਵ ਕਦ ਮਾਹ ਰੋ ਸੀਮ ਤਨ ॥
1418.t: k e sarav kadh maeh ro seem tan ||
1418.e: ‘O you, the one as tall as cypress tree, moon-faced and silvery body,

1418.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ੇ ਫ਼ਲਕ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਨ ॥੩੭॥
1418.t: charaag(h)e phalak aaphataabe yaman ||37||
1418.e: ‘You the light of the skies and sun of Yaman,(37)

1418.g: ਜੁਦਾਈ ਮਰਾ ਅਜ਼ ਤੁਰਾ ਕਤਰਹ ਨੇਸਤ ॥
1418.t: judhaiee maraa az turaa katareh nesat ||
1418.e: ‘I cannot live without you, even for a moment.

1418.g: ਬ ਦੀਦਨ ਦੁ ਕਾਲਬ ਬ ਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਮ ਯਕੇਸਤ ॥੩੮॥
1418.t: b dheedhan dh kaalab b g(h)uphatam yakesat ||38||
1418.e: ‘May be we seem to be two bodies but we are one.(38)

1418.g: ਬ ਮਨ ਹਾਲ ਗੋ ਤਾ ਚਿ ਗੁਜ਼ਰਦ ਤੁਰਾ ॥
1418.t: b man haal go taa ch guzaradh turaa ||
1418.e: ‘You tell me, how are you savouring?

1418.g: ਕਿ ਸੋਜ਼ਦ ਹਮਹ ਜਾਨ ਜਿਗਰੇ ਮਰਾ ॥੩੯॥
1418.t: k sozadh hameh jaan jigare maraa ||39||
1418.e: ‘My mind and body are always yearning for you.(39)

1418.g: ਕਿ ਪਿਨਹਾ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਕਰਦ ਯਾਰਾ ਖ਼ਤਾਸਤ ॥
1418.t: k pinahaa sukhhan karadh yaaraa khhataasat ||
1418.e: ‘To hide the fact from friends is erroneous.

1418.g: ਅਗਰ ਰਾਸ ਗੋਈ ਤੁ ਬਰ ਮਨ ਰਵਾਸਤ ॥੪੦॥
1418.t: agar raas goiee ta bar man ravaasat ||40||
1418.e: ‘To reveal the truth will be congenial for you and me.(40)

1418.g: ਕਿ ਦੀਗਰ ਬਗੋਯਮ ਮਰਾ ਰਾਸਤ ਗੋ ॥
1418.t: k dheegar bagoyam maraa raasat go ||
1418.e: ‘If you reveal the truth to me, I will never betray,

1418.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ੂਨ ਜਿਗਰੇ ਮਰਾ ਤੋ ਬਿਸ਼ੋ ॥੪੧॥
1418.t: k az khhoon jigare maraa to bisho ||41||
1418.e: ‘And I swear this on my life.(41)

1418.g: ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਦੁਜ਼ਦਗੀ ਕਰਦ ਯਾਰਾ ਖ਼ਤਾਸਤ ॥
1418.t: sukhhan dhuzadhagee karadh yaaraa khhataasat ||
1418.e: ‘To hide the fact from the friends is a sin,

1418.g: ਅਮੀਰਾਨ ਦੁਜ਼ਦੀ ਵਜ਼ੀਰਾ ਖ਼ਤਾਸਤ ॥੪੨॥
1418.t: ameeraan dhuzadhee vazeeraa khhataasat ||42||
1418.e: ‘Like the minister keeping secret from the king.(42)

1418.g: ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਨੇ ਰਾਸਤ ਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਨ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਅਸਤ ॥
1418.t: sukhhan guphatane raasat g(h)uphatan khhush asat ||
1418.e: ‘It is always beneficial to reveal and tell the fact.

1418.g: ਕਿ ਹਕ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਨੋ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਸਾਫ਼ੀ ਦਿਲ ਅਸਤ ॥੪੩॥
1418.t: k hak guphatano ham ch saaphee dhil asat ||43||
1418.e: ‘Speaking the truth is the norm of a truthful mind.’(43)

1418.g: ਬਸੇ ਬਾਰ ਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਸ਼ ਜਵਾਬੋ ਨ ਦਾਦ ॥
1418.t: base baar g(h)uphatash javaabo na dhaadh ||
1418.e: He asked repeatedly but there was no reply,

1418.g: ਜਵਾਬੇ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਸ਼ੀਰੀ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੪੪॥
1418.t: javaabe zubaa sukhhan sheeree kushaadh ||44||
1418.e: Although she had expressed to seek truth.(44)

1418.g: ਯਕੇ ਮਜਲਿਸ ਆਰਾਸਤ ਬਾ ਰੋਦ ਜਾਮ ॥
1418.t: yake majalis aaraasat baa rodh jaam ||
1418.e: Then he arranged a social gathering with so much music, and a drinking spree,

1418.g: ਕਿ ਹਮ ਮਸਤ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਮਜਲਸੇ ਓ ਤਮਾਮ ॥੪੫॥
1418.t: k ham masat shudh majalase o tamaam ||45||
1418.e: In which every one present in the assembly got drunk.(45)

1418.g: ਬ ਕੈਫ਼ਸ਼ ਹਮਹ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਆਵੇਖ਼ਤੰਦ ॥
1418.t: b kaiphash hameh ham ch aavekhhata(n)dh ||
1418.e: They all were getting so much intoxicated,

1418.g: ਕਿ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮੇ ਜਿਗਰ ਬਾਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਰੇਖ਼ਤੰਦ ॥੪੬॥
1418.t: k zakhhame jigar baazubaa rekhhata(n)dh ||46||
1418.e: That what ever there was in their hearts, they were blabbing out.(46)

1418.g: ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਬਾ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਗੋਯਦ ਮੁਦਾਮ ॥
1418.t: sukhhan baa zubaa ham ch goyadh mudhaam ||
1418.e: Their tongues were constantly reiterating,

1418.g: ਨ ਗੋਯਦ ਬਜੁਜ਼ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਮਹਬੂਬ ਨਾਮ ॥੪੭॥
1418.t: n goyadh bajuz sukhhan mahaboob naam ||47||
1418.e: And except their lovers’ names, they were uttering nothing.(47)

1418.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਮਜਲਿਸ ਆਰਾਸਤ ਬਾ ਰੋਦ ਚੰਗ ॥
1418.t: dhig(h)r majalis aaraasat baa rodh cha(n)g ||
1418.e: Then the daughter of Maulana, arranged another social,

1418.g: ਜਵਾਨਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਇਸਤਹੇ ਖ਼ੂਬ ਰੰਗ ॥੪੮॥
1418.t: javaanaan shaisatahe khhoob ra(n)g ||48||
1418.e: Which was just for the colourful young and handsome.(48)

1418.g: ਹਮਹ ਮਸਤ ਖ਼ੋ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਹਮਹ ਖ਼ੂਬ ਮਸਤ ॥
1418.t: hameh masat khho shudh hameh khhoob masat ||
1418.e: All of them became tipsy and inebriated,

1418.g: ਇਨਾਨੇ ਫ਼ਜ਼ੀਲਤ ਬਰੂੰ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਦਸਤ ॥੪੯॥
1418.t: einaane phazeelat baroo(n) shudh z dhasat ||49||
1418.e: And passed over the limits if intellectuals.(49)

1418.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਇਲਮ ਸੁਖ਼ਨਸ਼ ਬਿਰਾਦ ॥
1418.t: haraa kas k az ilam sukhhanash biraadh ||
1418.e: Any one who wanted to talk to them about education,

1418.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਬੇਖ਼ੁਦੀ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਦੋ ਬੁਖਾਦ ॥੫੦॥
1418.t: k az bekhhudhee naam haradho bukhaadh ||50||
1418.e: They, being drunk, kept on repeating their lovers’ names.(50)

1418.g: ਚੁ ਇਲਮੋ ਫ਼ਜ਼ੀਲਤ ਫਰਾਮੋਸ਼ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥
1418.t: ch ilamo phazeelat faraamosh gashat ||
1418.e: As the intellect and the presence of mind flew away,

1418.g: ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਬਾ ਯਕ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਨਾਮ ਮਸਤ ॥੫੧॥
1418.t: bukhhaadha(n)dh baa yak dhig(h)r naam masat ||51||
1418.e: They kept on reciting each other’s names only.(51)

1418.g: ਹਰਾ ਕਸ ਕਿ ਦੇਰੀਨਹ ਰਾ ਹਸਤ ਦੋਸਤ ॥
1418.t: haraa kas k dhereeneh raa hasat dhosat ||
1418.e: Every one who had some old friend,

1418.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਯਿੰਦਹ ਅਜ਼ ਨਾਮ ਓਸਤ ॥੫੨॥
1418.t: zubaa khhudh kushaayi(n)dheh az naam osat ||52||
1418.e: Would keep on repeating friends name again and again.(52)

1418.g: ਸ਼ਨਾਸ਼ਿਦ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਗੁਲ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਆਸ਼ਕ ਅਸਤ ॥
1418.t: shanaashidh k iee(n) gul sukhhan aashak asat ||
1418.e: As with such an action one was acknowledged as the lover,

1418.g: ਬ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਨ ਹੁਮਾਯੂੰ ਸੁਬਕ ਤਨ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਅਸਤ ॥੫੩॥
1418.t: b guphatan humaayoo(n) subak tan khhush asat ||53||
1418.e: Who could speak cordially and looked handsome and happy.(53)

1418.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਇਸ਼ਕ ਵ ਅਜ਼ ਮੁਸ਼ਕ ਅਜ਼ ਖ਼ਮਰ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥
1418.t: k az ishak v az mushak az khhamar khhoo(n) ||
1418.e: Those, who were imbued in love and smelled liquor,

1419.g: ਕਿ ਪਿਨਹਾ ਨ ਮਾਦ ਅਸਤ ਆਮਦ ਬਰੂੰ ॥੫੪॥
1419.t: k pinahaa na maadh asat aamadh baroo(n) ||54||
1419.e: Could not remain hidden and, in due course, were revealed.(54)

1419.g: ਬ ਸ਼ਹਰ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੁਹਰਤ ਪਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1419.t: b shahar a(n)dharoo(n) gashat shuharat pazeer ||
1419.e: The news spread in the city like a wild fire,

1419.g: ਕਿ ਆਜ਼ਾਦਹੇ ਸ਼ਾਹੁ ਵ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥੫੫॥
1419.t: k aazaadhahe shaahu v dhukhhatar vazeer ||55||
1419.e: That the son of the king and the daughter of the minister are openly in love.(55)

1419.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਈਂ ਸੁਖ਼ਨ ਸ਼ਹਿ ਦੁ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਬੁਖਾਦ ॥
1419.t: shuneedh iee(n) sukhhan sheh dh kishatee bukhaadh ||
1419.e: When the King heard this news, he asked for two boats.

1419.g: ਜੁਦਾ ਬਰ ਜੁਦਾ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੫੬॥
1419.t: judhaa bar judhaa har dh kishatee nishaadh ||56||
1419.e: He put them both in separate ferries.(56)

1419.g: ਰਵਾ ਕਰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਬ ਦਰੀਯਾ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1419.t: ravaa karadh o raa b dhareeyaa azeem ||
1419.e: He let loose both of them in the deep river,

1419.g: ਦੁ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਯਕੇ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਹਮਹ ਮੌਜ ਬੀਮ ॥੫੭॥
1419.t: dh kishatee yake shudh hameh mauaj beem ||57||
1419.e: But through the waves both the vessels joined together.(57)

1419.g: ਦੁ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਯਕੇ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਬ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅਲਾਹ ॥
1419.t: dh kishatee yake gashat b hukame alaeh ||
1419.e: By the grace of God, both were reunited,

1419.g: ਬ ਯਕ ਜਾ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਹੁਮਾ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ ਮਾਹ ॥੫੮॥
1419.t: b yak jaa dharaamadh humaa shamash maeh ||58||
1419.e: And both, like the sun and the moon, were amalgamated.(58)

1419.g: ਬੁਬੀਂ ਕੁਦਰਤੇ ਕਿਰਦਗਾਰੇ ਅਲਾਹ ॥
1419.t: bubee(n) kudharate kiradhagaare alaeh ||
1419.e: Look at the creation of Allah, the God Almighty,

1419.g: ਦੁ ਤਨ ਰਾ ਯਕੇ ਕਰਦ ਅਜ਼ ਹੁਕਮ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ॥੫੯॥
1419.t: dh tan raa yake karadh az hukam shaeh ||59||
1419.e: Through His order He merges the two bodies into one.(59)

1419.g: ਦੁ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਬ ਯਕ ਜਾ ਦੁ ਤਨ ॥
1419.t: dh kishatee dharaamadh b yak jaa dh tan ||
1419.e: United into one from two boats were two bodies,

1419.g: ਚਰਾਗ਼ੇ ਜਹਾ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬੇ ਯਮਨ ॥੬੦॥
1419.t: charaag(h)e jahaa aaphataabe yaman ||60||
1419.e: Of which one was light of Arabia and the other the moon of Yaman.(60)

1419.g: ਬਿ ਰਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਬ ਦਰੀਯਾਇ ਗਾਰ ॥
1419.t: b raphata(n)dh kishatee b dhareeyai gaar ||
1419.e: The boats had floated and entered into the deep waters.

1419.g: ਬ ਮੌਜ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਚੁ ਬਰਗੇ ਬਹਾਰ ॥੬੧॥
1419.t: b mauaj a(n)dhar aamadh ch barage bahaar ||61||
1419.e: And in the water they came floating like the spring leaves.(61)

1419.g: ਯਕੇ ਅਜ਼ਦਹਾ ਬੂਦ ਆਂ ਜਾ ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤ ॥
1419.t: yake azadhahaa boodh aa(n) jaa nishasat ||
1419.e: There, sat a huge snake,

1419.g: ਬ ਖ਼ੁਰਦਨ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਵਜ਼ਾ ਕਰਦ ਜਸਤ ॥੬੨॥
1419.t: b khhuradhan dharaamadh vazaa karadh jasat ||62||
1419.e: Which pounced forward to eat them.(62)

1419.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਪੇਸ਼ ਤਰ ਬੂਦ ਕਹਰੇ ਬਲਾ ॥
1419.t: dhig(h)r pesh tar boodh kahare balaa ||
1419.e: From the other end appeared a ghost,

1419.g: ਦੁ ਦਸਤਸ਼ ਸਤੂੰ ਕਰਦ ਬੇ ਸਰ ਨੁਮਾ ॥੬੩॥
1419.t: dh dhasatash satoo(n) karadh be sar numaa ||63||
1419.e: Who raised her hands, which looked like headless pillars.(63)

1419.g: ਮਿਯਾ ਰਫ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀਏ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਦਸਤ ॥
1419.t: miyaa raphat shudh kishate'ee har dh dhasat ||
1419.e: The boat slipped through under the protection of the hands,

1419.g: ਬਨੇਸ੍ਵੇ ਦਮਾਨਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਮਾਰ ਮਸਤ ॥੬੪॥
1419.t: banesavaie dhamaanadh azo maar masat ||64||
1419.e: And they both escaped the hidden intention of the snake,(64)

1419.g: ਗਰਿਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਬਦਸਤ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ॥
1419.t: gariphata(n)dh o raa badhasat a(n)dharoo(n) ||
1419.e: Which (the snake) had intended to catch them to suck (them).

1419.g: ਬ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਨ ਖ਼ੁਰਦੰਦ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥੬੫॥
1419.t: b bakhhasheedh o raa na khhuradha(n)dh khhoo(n) ||65||
1419.e: But the All Benevolent saved their blood.(65)

1419.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਜੰਗ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਅਜ਼ਦਹਾ ਬਾ ਬਲਾ ॥
1419.t: chunaa ja(n)g shudh azadhahaa baa balaa ||
1419.e: A war between snake and ghost was imminent,

1419.g: ਕਿ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਨਿਆਮਦ ਬ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ॥੬੬॥
1419.t: k beroo(n) niaamadh b hukame khhudhaa ||66||
1419.e: But, by God’s grace, it did not occur.(66)

1419.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਮੌਜ ਖ਼ੇਜ਼ਦ ਜਿ ਦਰੀਯਾ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1419.t: chunaa mauaj khhezadh j dhareeyaa azeem ||
1419.e: High waves sprung from the great river,

1419.g: ਕਿ ਦੀਗਰ ਨ ਦਾਨਿਸਤ ਜੁਜ਼ ਯਕ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੬੭॥
1419.t: k dheegar na dhaanisat juz yak kareem ||67||
1419.e: And this secret, except God, no body could acquiesce.(67)

1419.g: ਰਵਾ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਬ ਮੌਜੇ ਬਲਾ ॥
1419.t: ravaa gashat kishatee b mauaje balaa ||
1419.e: The rowing boat was struck with the high waves,

1419.g: ਬਰਾਹੇ ਖ਼ਲਾਸੀ ਜ਼ਿ ਰਹਮਤ ਖ਼ੁਦਾ ॥੬੮॥
1419.t: baraahe khhalaasee z rahamat khhudhaa ||68||
1419.e: And the incumbents prayed for escape.(68)

1419.g: ਬ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਹਮ ਅਜ਼ ਹੁਕਮ ਪਰਵਰਦਿਗਾਰ ॥
1419.t: b aakhhar ham az hukam paravaradhigaar ||
1419.e: At the end with the will of God, the Almighty,

1419.g: ਕਿ ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ ਬਰ ਆਮਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਦਰੀਯਾ ਕਿਨਾਰ ॥੬੯॥
1419.t: k kishatee bar aamadh z dhareeyaa kinaar ||69||
1419.e: The boat reached the safety of the bank.(69)

1419.g: ਕਿ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਬਰਾਮਦ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਤਨ ॥
1419.t: k beroo(n) baraamadh azaa har dh tan ||

1419.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਸਤਹ ਲਬੇ ਆਬ ਦਰੀਯਾ ਯਮਨ ॥੭੦॥
1419.t: nishasateh labe aab dhareeyaa yaman ||70||

1419.g: ਬਰਾਮਦ ਯਕੇ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਦੀਦਨ ਸ਼ਿਤਾਬ ॥
1419.t: baraamadh yake sher dheedhan shitaab ||
1419.e: Both of them came out of the boat,

1419.g: ਬ ਖ਼ੁਰਦਨ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਤਨ ਰਾ ਕਬਾਬ ॥੭੧॥
1419.t: b khhuradhan azaa har dh tan raa kabaab ||71||
1419.e: And sat down on the banks of the river.(71)

1419.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਦਰੀਯਾ ਬਰ ਆਮਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਮਗਰੇ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1419.t: z dhareeyaa bar aamadh z magare azeem ||
1419.e: Suddenly an alligator jumped out,

1419.g: ਖ਼ੁਰਮ ਹਰ ਦੁ ਤਨ ਰਾ ਬ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੭੨॥
1419.t: khhuram har dh tan raa b hukame kareem ||72||
1419.e: To eat them both as if it was God’s will.(72)

1419.g: ਬਜਾਇਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਸ਼ੇਰੇ ਸ਼ਿਤਾਬ ॥
1419.t: bajaish dharaamadh z shere shitaab ||
1419.e: Suddenly a lion appeared and it jumped ahead,

1419.g: ਗਜ਼ੰਦਸ਼ ਹਮੀ ਬੁਰਦ ਬਰ ਰੋਦ ਆਬ ॥੭੩॥
1419.t: gaza(n)dhash hamee buradh bar rodh aab ||73||
1419.e: It lunged over the water of the stream.(73)

1419.g: ਬ ਪੇਚੀਦ ਸਰ ਓ ਖ਼ਤਾ ਗਸ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੇਰ ॥
1419.t: b pecheedh sar o khhataa gashat sher ||
1419.e: They turned their heads, lion’s attack was deflected,

1419.g: ਬ ਦਹਨੇ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਅਫ਼ਤਦ ਦਲੇਰ ॥੭੪॥
1419.t: b dhahane dhig(h)r dhushaman aphatadh dhaler ||74||
1419.e: And its futile bravery put (lion) in other’s (alligator’s) mouth.(74)

1419.g: ਬ ਗੀਰਦ ਮਗਰ ਦਸਤ ਸ਼ੇਰੋ ਸ਼ਿਤਾਬ ॥
1419.t: b geeradh magar dhasat shero shitaab ||
1419.e: The alligator caught half of lion with its paw,

1419.g: ਬ ਬੁਰਦੰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਕਸ਼ੀਦਹ ਦਰ ਆਬ ॥੭੫॥
1419.t: b buradha(n)dh o raa kasheedheh dhar aab ||75||
1419.e: And dragged him into the deep water.(75)

1419.g: ਬੁਬੀਂ ਕੁਦਰਤੇ ਕਿਰਦਗਾਰੇ ਜਹਾ ॥
1419.t: bubee(n) kudharate kiradhagaare jahaa ||
1419.e: Look at the creations of the Creator of the Universe,

1419.g: ਕਿ ਈਂ ਰਾ ਬ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਕੁਸਤਸ਼ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥੭੬॥
1419.t: k iee(n) raa b bakhhasheedh kusatash azaa ||76||
1419.e: (He) endowed them life and annihilated the lion.(76)

1419.g: ਬਿ ਰਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਹਰਦੋ ਬ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅਮੀਰ ॥
1419.t: b raphata(n)dh haradho b hukame ameer ||
1419.e: Both embarked to act according the will of God,

1419.g: ਯਕੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਜ਼ਾਦਹ ਬ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥੭੭॥
1419.t: yake shaahazaadheh b dhukhhatar vazeer ||77||
1419.e: One was King’s son and the other Minister’s daughter.(77)

1419.g: ਬਿ ਅਫ਼ਤਾਦ ਹਰ ਦੋ ਬ ਦਸਤੇ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1419.t: b aphataadh har dho b dhasate azeem ||
1419.e: They both occupied a derelict place to relax,

1420.g: ਨ ਸ਼ਾਯਦ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਦੀਦ ਜੁਜ਼ ਯਕ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੭੮॥
1420.t: n shaayadh dhig(h)r dheedh juz yak kareem ||78||
1420.e: So that they could not be noticed by any body,(78)

1420.g: ਬ ਮੁਲਕੇ ਹਬਸ਼ ਆਮਦ ਆਂ ਨੇਕ ਖ਼ੋਇ ॥
1420.t: b mulake habash aamadh aa(n) nek khhoi ||
1420.e: They both had reached a congenial and amicable country,

1420.g: ਯਕੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਜ਼ਾਦਹ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਖ਼ੂਬ ਰੋਇ ॥੭੯॥
1420.t: yake shaahazaadheh dhig(h)r khhoob roi ||79||
1420.e: And one was the son of the king and other the daughter of the minister.(79)

1420.g: ਦਰ ਆਂ ਜਾ ਬਿਆਮਦ ਕਿ ਬਿਨਸ਼ਸਤਹ ਸ਼ਾਹ ॥
1420.t: dhar aa(n) jaa biaamadh k binashasateh shaeh ||
1420.e: Then they reached the place where a king was seated,

1420.g: ਨਸ਼ਸਤੰਦ ਸ਼ਬ ਰੰਗ ਜ਼ਰਰੀਂ ਕੁਲਾਹ ॥੮੦॥
1420.t: nashasata(n)dh shab ra(n)g zararee(n) kulaeh ||80||
1420.e: The king was as dark as night, and that black-ruler had a golden cap on.(80)

1420.g: ਬ ਦੀਦੰਦ ਓਰਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਦੰਦ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1420.t: b dheedha(n)dh oraa bukhhaadha(n)dh pesh ||
1420.e: He saw them and called them nearer him,

1420.g: ਬ ਗੁਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਕਿ ਏ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ ਕੇਸ਼ ॥੮੧॥
1420.t: b guphata(n)dh k e sher aazaadh kesh ||81||
1420.e: And said, ‘Oh my lion hearted ones and the ones of independent will,(81)

1420.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਮੁਲਕੇ ਕਦਾਮੀ ਤੁ ਬ ਮਨ ਬਗੋ ॥
1420.t: z mulake kadhaamee ta b man bago ||
1420.e: ‘What country you belong to and what is your name?

1420.g: ਚਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਿਰਾ ਤੋ ਬ ਈਂ ਤਰਫ਼ ਜੋ ॥੮੨॥
1420.t: ch naame kiraa to b iee(n) taraph jo ||82||
1420.e: ‘And who are you trying to find in this part of the world?’(82)

1420.g: ਵਗਰਨਹ ਮਰਾ ਤੋ ਨ ਗੋਈਂ ਚੁ ਰਾਸਤ ॥
1420.t: vagaraneh maraa to na goiee(n) ch raasat ||
1420.e: ‘If you don’t tell me the truth,

1420.g: ਕਿ ਮੁਰਦਨ ਸ਼ਿਤਾਬ ਅਸਤ ਏਜ਼ਦ ਗਵਾਹਸਤ ॥੮੩॥
1420.t: k muradhan shitaab asat ezadh gavaahasat ||83||
1420.e: ‘Then, God witness, your death is certain.’(83)

1420.g: ਸ਼ਹਿਨਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਪਿਸਰੇ ਮਮਾਯੰਦਰਾ ॥
1420.t: shahinashaeh pisare mamaaya(n)dharaa ||
1420.e: ‘I am the son of the ruler of the country of Mayindra,

1420.g: ਕਿ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ਅਸਤ ਈਂ ਨੌਜਵਾ ॥੮੪॥
1420.t: k dhukhhatar vazeer asat iee(n) nauajavaa ||84||
1420.e: ‘And she is the daughter of the Minister.’(84)

1420.g: ਹਕੀਕਤ ਬ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਸ਼ ਜ਼ਿ ਪੇਸ਼ੀਨਹ ਹਾਲ ॥
1420.t: hakeekat b guphatash z pesheeneh haal ||
1420.e: He narrated all what had happened previously,

1420.g: ਕਿ ਬਰਵੈ ਚੁ ਬੁਗਜ਼ਸ਼ਤ ਚੰਦੀਂ ਜ਼ਵਾਲ ॥੮੫॥
1420.t: k baravai ch bugazashat cha(n)dhee(n) zavaal ||85||
1420.e: And explained all the afflictions they had passed through.(85)

1420.g: ਬ ਮਿਹਰਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਬਗ਼ੁਫ਼ਤ ਅਜ਼ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ॥
1420.t: b miharash dharaamadh bag(h)uphat az zubaa ||
1420.e: He (King) was overwhelmed with their affection,

1420.g: ਮਰਾ ਖ਼ਾਨਹ ਜਾਏ ਜ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਖ਼ਾਨਹ ਦਾ ॥੮੬॥
1420.t: maraa khhaaneh jaae z khhudh khhaaneh dhaa ||86||
1420.e: And said, ‘Consider my house as your own.’(86)

1420.g: ਵਜ਼ਾਰਤ ਖ਼ੁਦਸ਼ ਰਾ ਤੁਰਾ ਮੇ ਦਿਹਮ ॥
1420.t: vazaarat khhudhash raa turaa me dhiham ||
1420.e: ‘I hand over to you my ministerial affairs,

1420.g: ਕੁਲਾਹੇ ਮੁਮਾਲਕ ਤੁ ਬਰ ਸਰ ਨਿਹਮ ॥੮੭॥
1420.t: kulaahe mumaalak ta bar sar niham ||87||
1420.e: ‘Along with that I will put several countries under your jurisdiction.’(87)

1420.g: ਬ ਗੁਫ਼ਤੰਦ ਈਂ ਰਾ ਵ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1420.t: b guphata(n)dh iee(n) raa v karadha(n)dh vazeer ||
1420.e: With this pronouncement he was appointed the Minister,

1420.g: ਕਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਜਾ ਬੂਦ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਜ਼ਮੀਰ ॥੮੮॥
1420.t: k naame vajaa boodh rauashan zameer ||88||
1420.e: And given the title of Roshan Zameer, the enlightened consciousness.(88)

1420.g: ਬ ਹਰ ਜਾ ਕਿ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਸ਼ਨਾਸਦ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1420.t: b har jaa k dhushaman shanaasadh azeem ||
1420.e: (After taking over,) Whenever he encountered an enemy,

1420.g: ਦਵੀਦੰਦ ਬਰਵੈ ਬ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੮੯॥
1420.t: dhaveedha(n)dh baravai b hukame kareem ||89||
1420.e: With God’s benevolence, he raided the adversary.(89)

1420.g: ਕਿ ਖ਼ੂਨਸ਼ ਬਰੇਜ਼ੀਦ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਜ਼ੇਰ ॥
1420.t: k khhoonash barezeedh karadha(n)dh zer ||
1420.e: He would not hesitate to spill his own blood,

1421.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਜਾ ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦੇ ਦਵੀਦੇ ਦਲੇਰ ॥੯੦॥
1421.t: dhig(h)r jaa shuneedhe dhaveedhe dhaler ||90||
1421.e: And would do the same at any other rebellious place.(90)

1421.g: ਬ ਹਰ ਜਾ ਕਿ ਤਰਕਸ਼ ਬਰੇਜ਼ੰਦ ਤੀਰ ॥
1421.t: b har jaa k tarakash bareza(n)dh teer ||
1421.e: Whenever he would shoot an arrow from his quiver,

1421.g: ਬ ਕੁਸ਼ਤੇ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਬ ਕਰਦੇ ਅਸੀਰ ॥੯੧॥
1421.t: b kushate adhooraa b karadhe aseer ||91||
1421.e: He would annihilate the enemy there and then.(91)

1421.g: ਬ ਮੁਦਤ ਯਕੇ ਸਾਲ ਤਾ ਚਾਰ ਮਾਹ ॥
1421.t: b mudhat yake saal taa chaar maeh ||
1421.e: When a period of one year and four months had lapsed,

1421.g: ਦਰਿਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਹ ਆਮਦ ਚੁ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ਿੰਦਹ ਮਾਹ ॥੯੨॥
1421.t: dharikhhashi(n)dheh aamadh ch rakhhashi(n)dheh maeh ||92||
1421.e: He became as famous in the country as the moon in the sky,(92)

1421.g: ਬਦੋਜ਼ੰਦ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨ ਬਸੋਜ਼ੰਦ ਤਨ ॥
1421.t: badhoza(n)dh dhushaman basoza(n)dh tan ||
1421.e: After stringing them through arrows he had nettled the enemies,

1421.g: ਬਯਾਦ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ਰੋਜ਼ਗਾਰੇ ਕੁਹਨ ॥੯੩॥
1421.t: bayaadh aamadhash rozagaare kuhan ||93||
1421.e: And reminisced on the old days.(93)

1421.g: ਬ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਸ਼ ਯਕੇ ਰੋਜ਼ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1421.t: b guphatash yake roz dhukhhatar vazeer ||
1421.e: One day the daughter of the minister said to him,

1421.g: ਕਿ ਏ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਨ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਜ਼ਮੀਰ ॥੯੪॥
1421.t: k e shaeh shaahaan rauashan zameer ||94||
1421.e: ‘Oh, you the king of kings and the enlightened one,(94)

1421.g: ਬ ਯਕ ਬਾਰ ਮੁਲਕਤ ਫ਼ਰਾਮੋਸ਼ ਗ਼ਸ਼ਤ ॥
1421.t: b yak baar mulakat pharaamosh g(h)shat ||
1421.e: ‘Instantly you have forgotten your own country,

1421.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਮਸਤ ਮਸਤੀ ਹਮਹ ਹੋਸ਼ ਗਸ਼ਤ ॥੯੫॥
1421.t: k az masat masatee hameh hosh gashat ||95||
1421.e: ‘And being adorned with success, you have forgotten your own- self.(95)

1421.g: ਤੁ ਆਂ ਮੁਲਕ ਪੇਸ਼ੀਨਹ ਰਾ ਯਾਦ ਕੁਨ ॥
1421.t: t aa(n) mulak pesheeneh raa yaadh kun ||
1421.e: ‘Remember your own country, ‘Where lies your paternal city.

1421.g: ਕਿ ਸ਼ਹਰੇ ਪਦਰ ਰਾ ਤੁ ਆਬਾਦ ਕੁਨ ॥੯੬॥
1421.t: k shahare padhar raa ta aabaadh kun ||96||
1421.e: You must go and rehabilitate it.’(96)

1421.g: ਨਿਗਹ ਦਾਸ਼ਤ ਅਜ਼ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਤਮਾਮ ॥
1421.t: nigeh dhaashat az phauaj lashakar tamaam ||
1421.e: He had always been keeping vigil on this army,

1421.g: ਬਸੇ ਗੰਜ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਬਰ ਵੈ ਮੁਦਾਮ ॥੯੭॥
1421.t: base ga(n)j bakhhasheedh bar vai mudhaam ||97||
1421.e: And had been distributing the wealth (among them).(97)

1421.g: ਯਕੇ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਆਰਾਸਤ ਚੂੰ ਨੌਬਹਾਰ ॥
1421.t: yake lashakar aaraasat choo(n) nauabahaar ||
1421.e: One of the contingent, he decorated like the spring season.

1421.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਖ਼ੰਜਰ ਵ ਗੁਰਜੋ ਵ ਬਕਤਰ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ॥੯੮॥
1421.t: z khha(n)jar v gurajo v bakatar hazaar ||98||
1421.e: He provided (them) thousands of daggers, and laced them with armours,(98)

1421.g: ਜ਼ਿਰਹ ਖ਼ੋਦ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਾਨ ਬਰਗਸ਼ਤਵਾਨ ॥
1421.t: zireh khhodh khhuphataan baragashatavaan ||
1421.e: Along with coat-of-mails, he gave them Hindustani swords,

1421.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਹਿੰਦੀ ਗਿਰਾ ਤਾ ਗਿਰਾਨ ॥੯੯॥
1421.t: z shamasher hi(n)dhee giraa taa giraan ||99||
1421.e: which were very heavy and expensive.(99)

1421.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਬੰਦੂਕ ਮਸਹਦ ਵ ਚੀਨੀ ਕਮਾਨ ॥
1421.t: z ba(n)dhook masahadh v cheenee kamaan ||
1421.e: Also (he gave them) the Guns from the country of Mashad,

1421.g: ਜ਼ਿਰਹ ਰੂਮ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਹਿੰਦੋਸਤਾਨ ॥੧੦੦॥
1421.t: zireh room shamasher hi(n)dhosataan ||100||
1421.e: Including chain-mails of Rome and scimitars of Hindustan.(100)

1421.g: ਚਿ ਅਜ਼ ਤਾਜ਼ੀ ਅਸਪਾਨ ਪੋਲਾਦ ਨਾਲ ॥
1421.t: ch az taazee asapaan polaadh naal ||
1421.e: They were provided with Arabian horses, (which were) outfitted with steel hooves.

1421.g: ਹਮਹ ਜੂ ਬਦਹ ਫ਼ੀਲਾਨ ਅਜਿਸ਼ ਬੇ ਮਸਾਲ ॥੧੦੧॥
1421.t: hameh joo badheh pheelaan ajish be masaal ||101||
1421.e: Along with all the stimulated elephants, which were as black as the night.(101)

1421.g: ਹਮਹ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਮਰਦਾ ਵ ਜ਼ੋਰਾਵਰਾ ॥
1421.t: hameh sher maradhaa v zoraavaraa ||
1421.e: All the fighters were very brave,

1421.g: ਕਿ ਸ਼ੇਰ ਅਫ਼ਕਨਾ ਰਾ ਬਸ਼ਫ਼ ਅਫ਼ਕਨਾ ॥੧੦੨॥
1421.t: k sher aphakanaa raa bashaph aphakanaa ||102||
1421.e: They, the lion hearted ones, could decimate lines after lines (of the enemies).(102)

1421.g: ਬਰਜ਼ਮ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਹਮਚੁ ਪੀਲ ਅਫ਼ਕਨ ਅਸਤ ॥
1421.t: barazam a(n)dharoo(n) hamach peel aphakan asat ||
1421.e: Although he was capable of killing an elephant,

1421.g: ਬਬਜ਼ਮ ਅੰਦਰੂੰ ਚਰਬ ਚਾਲਾਕ ਦਸਤ ॥੧੦੩॥
1421.t: babazam a(n)dharoo(n) charab chaalaak dhasat ||103||
1421.e: In the court he prevailed with very sweet tongue and wit.(103)

1421.g: ਨਿਸ਼ਾ ਮੇ ਦਿਹਦ ਨੇਜ਼ਹ ਰਾ ਨੋਕ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥
1421.t: nishaa me dhihadh nezeh raa nok khhoo(n) ||
1421.e: His spear was captivating,

1421.g: ਕਸ਼ੀਦੰਦ ਅਜ਼ ਤੇਗ਼ ਜ਼ਹਿਰ ਆਬ ਗੂੰ ॥੧੦੪॥
1421.t: kasheedha(n)dh az teg(h) zahir aab goo(n) ||104||
1421.e: And the swords were tempered with the poison.(104)

1421.g: ਯਕੇ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਆਰਾਸਤਹ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਕੋਹ ॥
1421.t: yake phauaj aaraasateh ham ch koh ||
1421.e: A pyramid of the army was established, which was,

1421.g: ਜੁਵਾਨਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਇਸਤਹੇ ਯਕ ਗਰੋਹ ॥੧੦੫॥
1421.t: juvaanaan shaisatahe yak garoh ||105||
1421.e: Constituted of very handsome young-men,(105)

1421.g: ਬਪੋਸ਼ੀਦ ਦਸਤਾਰ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1421.t: baposheedh dhasataar dhukhhatar vazeer ||
1421.e: The daughter of the Minister put the turban on,

1421.g: ਬ ਬਸਤੰਦ ਸ਼ਮਸ਼ੇਰ ਜੁਸਤੰਦ ਤੀਰ ॥੧੦੬॥
1421.t: b basata(n)dh shamasher jusata(n)dh teer ||106||
1421.e: And took a quiver full of arrows.(106)

1421.g: ਬ ਸਰਦਾਰੀਏ ਕਰਦ ਪੇਸ਼ੀਨਹ ਫ਼ੌਜ ॥
1421.t: b saradhaare'e karadh pesheeneh phauaj ||
1421.e: Leading the frontal detachments,

1421.g: ਰਵਾ ਕਰਦ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਚੁ ਦਰੀਯਾਇ ਮੌਜ ॥੧੦੭॥
1421.t: ravaa karadh lashakar ch dhareeyai mauaj ||107||
1421.e: She led the army like the flowing river.(107)

1421.g: ਯਕੇ ਗੋਲ ਬਸਤਹ ਚੁ ਅਬਰੇ ਸਿਯਾਹ ॥
1421.t: yake gol basateh ch abare siyaeh ||
1421.e: Like a black cloud, when one contingent was despatched,

1421.g: ਬ ਲਰਜ਼ੀਦ ਬੂਮੋ ਬ ਲਰਜ਼ੀਦ ਮਾਹ ॥੧੦੮॥
1421.t: b larazeedh boomo b larazeedh maeh ||108||
1421.e: The earth shook and the moon trembled.(108)

1421.g: ਬਿਯਾਵੁਰਦ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਚੁ ਬਰ ਵੈ ਹਦੂਦ ॥
1421.t: biyaavuradh lashakar ch bar vai hadhoodh ||
1421.e: When the border was butted by the army,

1421.g: ਸਲਾਹੇ ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਤੀਰ ਤੇਗ਼ੋ ਨਮੂਦ ॥੧੦੯॥
1421.t: salaahe dhig(h)r teer teg(h)o namoodh ||109||
1421.e: Which was equipped with arrows, swords and many other arms,(109)

1421.g: ਬਿਆਰਾਸਤ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਬ ਸਾਜ਼ੇ ਤਮਾਮ ॥
1421.t: biaaraasat lashakar b saaze tamaam ||
1421.e: And also provided were the weapons,

1421.g: ਹਮਹ ਖ਼ੰਜਰੋ ਗੁਰਜ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੧੦॥
1421.t: hameh khha(n)jaro guraj gopaal naam ||110||
1421.e: Known as daggers, maces and slingshots,(110)

1421.g: ਬ ਬੁਰਦੰਦ ਅਕਲੀਮ ਤਾ ਰਾਜ ਤਖ਼ਤ ॥
1421.t: b buradha(n)dh akaleem taa raaj takhhat ||
1421.e: Then was plundered the country of Akleem,

1421.g: ਬ ਬੁਰਦਨ ਸ਼ਹੇ ਬਾਦ ਪਾਯਾਨ ਰਖ਼ਤ ॥੧੧੧॥
1421.t: b buradhan shahe baadh paayaan rakhhat ||111||
1421.e: And one ruler took away the flying-horses and other outfits.(111)

1421.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਜੰਗ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਆਂ ਮੁਲਕ ਰਾ ॥
1421.t: chunaa ja(n)g karadha(n)dh aa(n) mulak raa ||
1421.e: The worn-torn country was left like,

1421.g: ਚੁ ਬਰਗੇ ਦਰਖ਼ਤਾ ਜ਼ਿ ਬਾਦੇ ਸਬਾ ॥੧੧੨॥
1421.t: ch barage dharakhhataa z baadhe sabaa ||112||
1421.e: The trees, which are made barren during the fall.(112)

1421.g: ਬ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਨ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਯਦ ਬ ਪੇਸ਼ ॥
1421.t: b kushatan adhooraa kushaayadh b pesh ||
1421.e: The defeat of the enemy opened all the annuls to march forward,

1421.g: ਬ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਜ਼ਿ ਮੁਲਕਸ਼ ਹਮਹ ਰੂਹ ਰੇਸ਼ ॥੧੧੩॥
1421.t: b beroo(n) z mulakash hameh rooh resh ||113||
1421.e: And the opponents were left behind humiliated.(113)

1421.g: ਪਰੀ ਚਿਹਰਏ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਸ਼ੇਰੇ ਨਿਯਾਦ ॥
1421.t: paree chihare ham ch shere niyaadh ||
1421.e: Her fairy-like features depicted the lion’s courage,

1422.g: ਬ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਨ ਅਦੂਰਾ ਕਿ ਖ਼ੰਜਰ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੧੧੪॥
1422.t: b kushatan adhooraa k khha(n)jar kushaadh ||114||
1422.e: And she drew her dagger out of scabbard with great gusto.(114)

1422.g: ਬ ਹਰ ਜਾ ਦਵੀਦੇ ਬ ਕੁਸ਼ਤੇ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥
1422.t: b har jaa dhaveedhe b kushate azaa ||
1422.e: Who so ever she raided, she annihilated,

1422.g: ਬ ਹਰ ਜਾ ਰਸ਼ੀਦੇ ਬ ਬਸਤੇ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥੧੧੫॥
1422.t: b har jaa rasheedhe b basate azaa ||115||
1422.e: And captured the place and claimed it as her own.(115)

1422.g: ਸ਼ੁਨੀਦ ਈਂ ਅਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਮਾਯੰਦਰਾ ॥
1422.t: shuneedh iee(n) azaa shaeh maaya(n)dharaa ||
1422.e: When the ruler of Mayindra heard,

1422.g: ਬ ਤੁੰਦੀ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਬਜਾਇਸ਼ ਹੁਮਾ ॥੧੧੬॥
1422.t: b tu(n)dhee dharaamadh bajaish humaa ||116||
1422.e: He marched towards that place.(116)

1422.g: ਬ ਆਰਾਸਤਹ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਚੂੰ ਨੌਬਹਾਰ ॥
1422.t: b aaraasateh phauaj choo(n) nauabahaar ||
1422.e: He aligned his forces like the crops of spring,

1422.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੋਪੇ ਤੁਪਕ ਖ਼ੰਜਰੇ ਆਬਦਾਰ ॥੧੧੭॥
1422.t: z tope tupak khha(n)jare aabadhaar ||117||
1422.e: In opposition to the ones who were standing there fully armed.(117)

1422.g: ਬਪੇਸ਼ੇ ਸ਼ਫ਼ ਆਮਦ ਚੁ ਦਰਯਾ ਅਮੀਕ ॥
1422.t: bapeshe shaph aamadh ch dharayaa ameek ||
1422.e: Like a wave from deep sea marched them,

1422.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਸਰਤਾ ਕਦਮ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਆਹਨ ਗ਼ਰੀਕ ॥੧੧੮॥
1422.t: z sarataa kadham ham ch aahan g(h)reek ||118||
1422.e: Who were shielded by the steel armour from head to feet.(118)

1422.g: ਬ ਆਵਾਜ਼ ਤੋਪੋ ਤਮਾਚਹ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥
1422.t: b aavaaz topo tamaacheh tupha(n)g ||
1422.e: The uproars from guns, pistols and cannons overpowered,

1422.g: ਜ਼ਿਮੀ ਗ਼ਸ਼ਤ ਹਮ ਚੂੰ ਗੁਲੇ ਲਾਲਹ ਰੰਗ ॥੧੧੯॥
1422.t: zimee g(h)shat ham choo(n) gule laaleh ra(n)g ||119||
1422.e: And earth became reddish like crimson flowers.(119)

1422.g: ਬਮੈਦਾ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਕਿ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1422.t: bamaidhaa dharaamadh k dhukhhatar vazeer ||
1422.e: She, herself, came into the fighting fields,

1422.g: ਬ ਯਕ ਦਸਤ ਚੀਨੀ ਕਮਾ ਦਸਤ ਤੀਰ ॥੧੨੦॥
1422.t: b yak dhasat cheenee kamaa dhasat teer ||120||
1422.e: With a Chinese bow in one hand and the arrows in the other.(120)

1422.g: ਬ ਹਰਜਾ ਕਿ ਪਰਰਾ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਤੀਰ ਦਸਤ ॥
1422.t: b harajaa k pararaa shavadh teer dhasat ||
1422.e: Whenever she hurtled them through her hands,

1422.g: ਬ ਸਦ ਪਹਿਲੂਏ ਪੀਲ ਮਰਦਾ ਗੁਜ਼ਸ਼ਤ ॥੧੨੧॥
1422.t: b sadh pahilooe peel maradhaa guzashat ||121||
1422.e: The arrows pierced through the ribs of men and the elephants.(121)

1422.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਮੌਜ਼ ਖ਼ੇਜ਼ਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਦਰੀਯਾਬ ਸੰਗ ॥
1422.t: chunaa mauaz khhezadh z dhareeyaab sa(n)g ||
1422.e: The way the waves of the river struck the stones,

1422.g: ਬਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਚੁ ਤੇਗ਼ੋ ਨਿਹੰਗ ॥੧੨੨॥
1422.t: barakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh ch teg(h)o niha(n)g ||122||
1422.e: The swords of the warriors were striking sparklingly.(122)

1422.g: ਬ ਤਾਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਯਕੇ ਤਾਬ ਨਾਕ ॥
1422.t: b taabash dharaamadh yake taab naak ||
1422.e: The brilliance of the shining (swords) was prevailing all over,

1422.g: ਬ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਯਕੇ ਖ਼ੂਨ ਖ਼ਾਕ ॥੧੨੩॥
1422.t: b rakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh yake khhoon khhaak ||123||
1422.e: And in the shine, the blood and the soil were indistinguishable.(123)

1422.g: ਬ ਤਾਮਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਹਮਹ ਹਿੰਦ ਤੇਗ਼ ॥
1422.t: b taamash dharaamadh hameh hi(n)dh teg(h) ||
1422.e: The swords of Hindustan glittered,

1422.g: ਬ ਗੁਰਰੀਦ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਚੁ ਦਰੀਯਾਇ ਮੇਗ਼ ॥੧੨੪॥
1422.t: b gurareedh lashakar ch dhareeyai meg(h) ||124||
1422.e: And roared like thronging clouds over the river in flood.(124)

1422.g: ਬ ਚਰਖ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਬ ਚੀਨੀ ਕਮਾ ॥
1422.t: b charakhh a(n)dhar aamadh b cheenee kamaa ||
1422.e: Chinese bows radiated,

1422.g: ਬ ਤਾਬ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ਤੇਗ਼ ਹਿੰਦੋਸਤਾ ॥੧੨੫॥
1422.t: b taab aamadhash teg(h) hi(n)dhosataa ||125||
1422.e: And the Hindustani swords glittered.(125)

1422.g: ਗਰੇਵਹ ਬਬਾਵੁਰਦ ਚੰਦੀ ਕਰੋਹ ॥
1422.t: gareveh babaavuradh cha(n)dhee karoh ||
1422.e: The noises, which were overwhelming for many miles,

1422.g: ਬ ਲਰਜ਼ੀਦ ਦਰਯਾਬ ਦਰਰੀਦ ਕੋਹ ॥੧੨੬॥
1422.t: b larazeedh dharayaab dharareedh koh ||126||
1422.e: Made the rivers desperate and severed the mountains.(126)

1422.g: ਬ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਜ਼ਿਮੀਨੋ ਜ਼ਮਾ ॥
1422.t: b rakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh zimeeno zamaa ||
1422.e: But when the swords of Yaman kindled,

1422.g: ਬ ਤਾਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਚੁ ਤੇਗ਼ੇ ਯਮਾ ॥੧੨੭॥
1422.t: b taabash dharaamadh ch teg(h)e yamaa ||127||
1422.e: Both the sky and the earth kindled too.(127)

1422.g: ਬ ਤੇਜ਼ ਆਮਦੋ ਨੇਜ਼ਹੇ ਬਾਸਤੀਂ ॥
1422.t: b tez aamadho nezahe baasatee(n) ||
1422.e: When a bamboo spear appeared coming fast,

1422.g: ਬ ਜੁੰਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਤਨੇ ਨਾਜ਼ਨੀਂ ॥੧੨੮॥
1422.t: b ju(n)bash dharaamadh tane naazanee(n) ||128||
1422.e: And the delicate lady flew in rage.(128)

1422.g: ਬ ਸ਼ੋਰਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਨਫ਼ਰ ਹਾਇ ਕੁਹਿਰ ॥
1422.t: b shorash dharaamadh naphar hai kuhir ||
1422.e: The people raised a hue and cry,

1422.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੋਪੋ ਵ ਨੇਜ਼ਹ ਬਪੋਸ਼ੀਦ ਦਹਿਰ ॥੧੨੯॥
1422.t: z topo v nezeh baposheedh dhahir ||129||
1422.e: And the earth shook with the roar of guns.(129)

1422.g: ਬ ਜੁੰਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਕਮੰਦ ॥
1422.t: b ju(n)bash dharaamadh kamaano kama(n)dh ||
1422.e: The bows and the slingshots came into action fiercely,

1422.g: ਦਰਖ਼ਸ਼ਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਤੇਗ਼ ਸੀਮਾਬ ਤੁੰਦ ॥੧੩੦॥
1422.t: dharakhhashaa shudheh teg(h) seemaab tu(n)dh ||130||
1422.e: And the Hindustani swords, shining like the mercury, commenced to penetrate.(130)

1422.g: ਬ ਜੋਸ਼ ਆਮਦਹ ਖ਼ੰਜਰੇ ਖ਼੍ਵਾਰ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥
1422.t: b josh aamadheh khha(n)jare khhavaiaar khhoo(n) ||
1422.e: The blood sucking daggers appeared,

1422.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਨੇਜ਼ਹ ਮਾਰਸ਼ ਬਰਾਮਦ ਬਰੂੰ ॥੧੩੧॥
1422.t: zubaa nezeh maarash baraamadh baroo(n) ||131||
1422.e: And the lances, as sharp as snakes’ tongues, came into action.(131)

1422.g: ਬ ਤਾਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਲਕੋ ਤਾਬ ਨਾਕ ॥
1422.t: b taabash dharaamadh lako taab naak ||
1422.e: The shinning arms were gleaming,

1422.g: ਯਕੇ ਸੁਰਖ਼ ਗੋਗਿਰਦ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਖੂੰਨ ਖ਼ਾਕ ॥੧੩੨॥
1422.t: yake surakhh gogiradh shudh khoo(n)n khhaak ||132||
1422.e: And earth was getting darker like the sulphur.(132)

1422.g: ਦਿਹਾ ਦਿਹ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥
1422.t: dhihaa dheh dharaamadh z teero tupha(n)g ||
1422.e: Guns and the bows roared, and roared again,

1422.g: ਹਯਾਹਯ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਨਿਹੰਗੋ ਨਿਹੰਗ ॥੧੩੩॥
1422.t: hayaahay dharaamadh niha(n)go niha(n)g ||133||
1422.e: And the soldiers as huge as the crocodiles started to cry.(133)

1422.g: ਚਕਾਚਾਕ ਬਰਖ਼ਾਸਤ ਤੀਰੋ ਕਮਾ ॥
1422.t: chakaachaak barakhhaasat teero kamaa ||
1422.e: The spontaneous sprinkle of showers from bows,

1422.g: ਬਰਾਮਦ ਯਕੇ ਰੁਸਤ ਖ਼ੇਜ਼ ਅਜ਼ ਜਹਾ ॥੧੩੪॥
1422.t: baraamadh yake rusat khhez az jahaa ||134||
1422.e: Seemed as if the dooms day had come.(134)

1422.g: ਨ ਪੋਯਿੰਦਰ ਰਾ ਬਰ ਜ਼ਿਮੀ ਬੂਦ ਜਾ ॥
1422.t: n poyi(n)dhar raa bar zimee boodh jaa ||
1422.e: Neither the foot soldiers had a place on earth,

1422.g: ਨ ਪਰਿੰਦਹ ਰਾ ਦਰ ਹਵਾ ਬੂਦ ਰਾਹ ॥੧੩੫॥
1422.t: n pari(n)dheh raa dhar havaa boodh raeh ||135||
1422.e: Nor the birds could find their ways through the air.(135)

1422.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਤੇਗ਼ ਬਾਰੀਦ ਮਿਯਾਨੇ ਮੁਸਾਫ਼ ॥
1422.t: chunaa teg(h) baareedh miyaane musaaph ||
1422.e: The swords showed their feats in such intensity,

1422.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਕੁਸ਼ਤਗਾ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਜ਼ਿਮੀ ਕੋਹਕਾਫ਼ ॥੧੩੬॥
1422.t: k az kushatagaa shudh zimee kohakaaph ||136||
1422.e: That the dead bodies formed the mountains.(136)

1422.g: ਕਿ ਪਾਓ ਸਰ ਅੰਬੋਹ ਚੰਦਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ॥
1422.t: k paao sar a(n)boh cha(n)dhaa shudheh ||
1422.e: The heaps of heads and feet were all over,

1422.g: ਕਿ ਮੈਦਾ ਪੁਰ ਅਜ਼ ਗੋਇ ਚੌਗਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ॥੧੩੭॥
1422.t: k maidhaa pur az goi chauagaa shudheh ||137||
1422.e: And the whole field looked like golf course with heads rolling as balls.(137)

1422.g: ਰਵਾ ਰਉ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਬ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥
1422.t: ravaa rau dharaamadh b teero tupha(n)g ||
1422.e: The intensity of the arrows was so great;

1423.g: ਕਿ ਪਾਰਹ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਖ਼ੋਦ ਖ਼ੁਫ਼ਤਾਨ ਜੰਗ ॥੧੩੮॥
1423.t: k paareh shudheh khhodh khhuphataan ja(n)g ||138||
1423.e: That the armours and the hardtops were shattered.(138)

1423.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਤੇਗ਼ ਤਾਬਸ਼ ਤ ਪੀਦ ਆਫ਼ਤਾਬ ॥
1423.t: chunaa teg(h) taabash ta peedh aaphataab ||
1423.e: The swords were becoming as hot as the sun,

1423.g: ਦਰਖ਼ਤਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਕ ਵ ਦਰਯਾਇ ਆਬ ॥੧੩੯॥
1423.t: dharakhhataa shudheh khhushak v dharayai aab ||139||
1423.e: And the trees were getting thirsty and river-water was drying.(139)

1423.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਤੀਰ ਬਾਰਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਬਰਕੁ ॥
1423.t: chunaa teer baaraa shudheh ham ch barak ||
1423.e: The showers of the arrows were so great,

1423.g: ਬਿਅਫ਼ਤਾਦ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਫ਼ੀਲ ਚੂੰ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਫ਼ਰਕ ॥੧੪੦॥
1423.t: biaphataadh shudh pheel choo(n) pharak pharak ||140||
1423.e: That only the necks of the elephants were visible.(140)

1423.g: ਬ ਹਰਬ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਵਜ਼ੀਰੇ ਚੁ ਬਾਦ ॥
1423.t: b harab a(n)dhar aamadh vazeere ch baadh ||
1423.e: Instantly a Minister entered the field,

1423.g: ਯਕੇ ਤੇਗ਼ ਮਾਯੰਦਰਾਨੀ ਕੁਸ਼ਾਦ ॥੧੪੧॥
1423.t: yake teg(h) maaya(n)dharaanee kushaadh ||141||
1423.e: And he drew the sword of Mayindra.(141)

1423.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਤਰਫ਼ ਆਮਦ ਬ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਅਜ਼ਾ ॥
1423.t: dhig(h)r taraph aamadh b dhukhhatar azaa ||
1423.e: From the other side the daughter came.

1423.g: ਬਰਹਿਨੇ ਯਕੇ ਤੇਗ਼ ਹਿੰਦੋਸਤਾ ॥੧੪੨॥
1423.t: barahine yake teg(h) hi(n)dhosataa ||142||
1423.e: She was holding a naked sword of Hindustan.(142)

1423.g: ਦਰਖ਼ਸ਼ਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਆਂ ਚੁਨਾ ਤੇਗ਼ ਤੇਜ਼ ॥
1423.t: dharakhhashaa shudheh aa(n) chunaa teg(h) tez ||
1423.e: The lightening swords became even swifter,

1423.g: ਅਦੂਰਾ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਦਿਲ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਰੇਜ਼ ਰੇਜ਼ ॥੧੪੩॥
1423.t: adhooraa azo dhil shavadh rez rez ||143||
1423.e: And they tore off the enemy-hearts into pieces.(143)

1423.g: ਯਕੇ ਤੇਗ਼ ਜ਼ਦ ਬਰ ਸਰੇ ਓ ਸਮੰਦ ॥
1423.t: yake teg(h) zadh bar sare o sama(n)dh ||
1423.e: She hit the enemy head with such vitality,

1423.g: ਜ਼ਿਮੀਨਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਚੁ ਕੋਹੇ ਬਿਲੰਦ ॥੧੪੪॥
1423.t: zimeenash dharaamadh ch kohe bila(n)dh ||144||
1423.e: That he was raised to ground like a crumbling mountain.(144)

1423.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਤੇਗ਼ ਓ ਰਾ ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਕਰਦ ਨੀਮ ॥
1423.t: dhig(h)r teg(h) o raa bizadh karadh neem ||
1423.e: The second one was cut with sword into two,

1423.g: ਬਿ ਅਫ਼ਤਾਦ ਬੂਮਸ ਚੁ ਕਰਖੇ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥੧੪੫॥
1423.t: b aphataadh boomas ch karakhe azeem ||145||
1423.e: And he fell flat like a wrecked mansion.(145)

1423.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਮਰਦ ਆਮਦ ਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਰਾ ਉਕਾਬ ॥
1423.t: dhig(h)r maradh aamadh ch praraa ukaab ||
1423.e: Another intrepid person flew in like a hawk,

1423.g: ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਤੇਗ਼ ਓ ਰਾ ਬ ਕਰਦਸ਼ ਖ਼ਰਾਬ ॥੧੪੬॥
1423.t: bizadh teg(h) o raa b karadhash khharaab ||146||
1423.e: But he was, too, exterminated.(146)

1423.g: ਚੁ ਕਾਰੇ ਵਜ਼ੀਰਸ਼ ਬਰਾਹਤ ਰਸੀਦ ॥
1423.t: ch kaare vazeerash baraahat raseedh ||
1423.e: As soon this task was finished,

1423.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਮਿਹਨਤੇ ਸਿਯਮ ਆਮਦ ਪਦੀਦ ॥੧੪੭॥
1423.t: dhig(h)r mihanate siyam aamadh padheedh ||147||
1423.e: And the relief was felt, third discordant surfaced,(147)

1423.g: ਸਿਯਮ ਦੇਵ ਆਮਦ ਬਗਲ ਤੀਦ ਖ਼ੂੰ ॥
1423.t: siyam dhev aamadh bagal teedh khhoo(n) ||
1423.e: Another devil-like, drenched in blood, appeared,

1423.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਦਹਲੀਜ਼ ਦੋਜ਼ਖ਼ ਬਰਾਮਦ ਬਰੂੰ ॥੧੪੮॥
1423.t: z dhahaleez dhozakhh baraamadh baroo(n) ||148||
1423.e: As if it had come straight from the hell.(148)

1423.g: ਬ ਕੁਸ਼ਤੰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਦੁ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਤਨ ॥
1423.t: b kushata(n)dh o raa dh karadha(n)dh tan ||
1423.e: But he was cut into two as well and slaughtered,

1423.g: ਚੁ ਸ਼ੇਰੇ ਯਿਆਂ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਗੋਰੇ ਕੁਹਨ ॥੧੪੯॥
1423.t: ch shere yiaa(n) ham ch gore kuhan ||149||
1423.e: Like a lion slays an old antelope.(149)

1423.g: ਚਹਾਰਮ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਚੁ ਸ਼ੇਰਾ ਬਜੰਗ ॥
1423.t: chahaaram dharaamadh ch sheraa baja(n)g ||
1423.e: The fourth valiant person entered the fight,

1423.g: ਚੁ ਬਰ ਬਚਹੇ ਗੋਰ ਗ਼ਰਰਾ ਪਿਲੰਗ ॥੧੫੦॥
1423.t: ch bar bachahe gor g(h)raraa pila(n)g ||150||
1423.e: Like a lion pounces upon a stag.(150)

1423.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਤੇਗ਼ ਬਰ ਵੈ ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਨਾਜ਼ਨੀਂ ॥
1423.t: chunaa teg(h) bar vai bizadh naazanee(n) ||
1423.e: It was hit with such a force,

1423.g: ਕਿ ਅਜ਼ ਪੁਸ਼ਤ ਅਸਪਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਜ਼ਿਮੀਂ ॥੧੫੧॥
1423.t: k az pushat asapash dharaamadh zimee(n) ||151||
1423.e: That it fell flat like a rider from the horse.(151)

1423.g: ਕਿ ਪੰਚਮ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਚੁ ਦੇਵੇ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1423.t: k pa(n)cham dharaamadh ch dheve azeem ||
1423.e: When the fifth devil came,

1423.g: ਯਕੇ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮ ਜ਼ਦ ਕਰਦ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੀਮ ॥੧੫੨॥
1423.t: yake zakhham zadh karadh hukame kareem ||152||
1423.e: She begged for the God’s blessings,(152)

1423.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਤੇਗ਼ ਬਰ ਵੈ ਜ਼ਦਾ ਖ਼ੂਬ ਰੰਗ ॥
1423.t: chunaa teg(h) bar vai zadhaa khhoob ra(n)g ||
1423.e: And hit him with such great intensity,

1423.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਸਰ ਤਾ ਕਦਮ ਆਮਦਹ ਜ਼ੇਰ ਤੰਗ ॥੧੫੩॥
1423.t: z sar taa kadham aamadheh zer ta(n)g ||153||
1423.e: That his head was trodden under the hooves of the horse.(153)

1423.g: ਸ਼ਸ਼ਮ ਦੇਵ ਆਮਦ ਚੁ ਅਫ਼ਰੀਤ ਮਸਤ ॥
1423.t: shasham dhev aamadh ch aphareet masat ||
1423.e: Revelling like a stupefied demon, the sixth devil came,

1423.g: ਜ਼ਿ ਤੀਰੇ ਕਮਾ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਕਬਜ਼ਹ ਗੁਜ਼ਸ਼ਤ ॥੧੫੪॥
1423.t: z teere kamaa ham ch kabazeh guzashat ||154||
1423.e: As fast as an arrow shot out of the bow,(154)

1423.g: ਬਿਜ਼ਦ ਤੇਗ਼ ਓ ਰਾ ਕਿ ਓ ਨੀਮ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥
1423.t: bizadh teg(h) o raa k o neem shudh ||
1423.e: But it was hit so rapidly that he was cut into two,

1423.g: ਕਿ ਦੀਗਰ ਯਲਾ ਰਾ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਬੀਮ ਸ਼ੁਦ ॥੧੫੫॥
1423.t: k dheegar yalaa raa azo beem shudh ||155||
1423.e: And that caused the others to dread.(155)

1423.g: ਚੁਨੀ ਤਾ ਬਮਿਕਦਾਰ ਹਫ਼ਤਾਦ ਮਰਦ ॥
1423.t: chunee taa bamikadhaar haphataadh maradh ||
1423.e: This way about seventy such braves were annihilated,

1423.g: ਬ ਤੇਗ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਵੇਖ਼ਤ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਅਜ਼ ਨ ਬਰਦ ॥੧੫੬॥
1423.t: b teg(h) a(n)dhar aavekhhat khhaas az na baradh ||156||
1423.e: And hung over the tips of the swords,(156)

1423.g: ਦਿਗ਼ਰ ਕਸ ਨਿਆਮਦ ਤਮੰਨਾਇ ਜੰਗ ॥
1423.t: dhig(h)r kas niaamadh tama(n)nai ja(n)g ||
1423.e: None other could dare to think of fight,

1423.g: ਕਿ ਬੇਰੂੰ ਨਿਯਾਮਦ ਦਿਲਾਵਰ ਨਿਹੰਗ ॥੧੫੭॥
1423.t: k beroo(n) niyaamadh dhilaavar niha(n)g ||157||
1423.e: Even the prominent warriors did not dare to come out.(157)

1423.g: ਬ ਹਰਬ ਆਮਦਸ਼ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਮਾਯੰਦਰਾ ॥
1423.t: b harab aamadhash shaeh maaya(n)dharaa ||
1423.e: When the king, Mayindra, himself came into the fight,

1423.g: ਬ ਤਾਬਸ਼ ਤਪੀਦਨ ਦਿਲੇ ਮਰਦਮਾ ॥੧੫੮॥
1423.t: b taabash tapeedhan dhile maradhamaa ||158||
1423.e: All the fighters rolled into wrath.(158)

1423.g: ਚੁ ਅਬਰਸ ਬ ਅੰਦਾਖ਼ਤ ਦਉਰੇ ਯਲਾ ॥
1423.t: ch abaras b a(n)dhaakhhat dhaure yalaa ||
1423.e: And when the combatants jumped around,

1423.g: ਬ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਜ਼ਿਹੇ ਆਸਮਾ ॥੧੫੯॥
1423.t: b rakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh zihe aasamaa ||159||
1423.e: Both the earth and the heavens swayed.(159)

1423.g: ਬ ਤਾਬਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਜ਼ਿਮੀਨੋ ਜ਼ਮਨ ॥
1423.t: b taabash dharaamadh zimeeno zaman ||
1423.e: The lightening captured the universe,

1423.g: ਦਰਖ਼ਸ਼ਾ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਤੇਗ਼ ਹਿੰਦੀ ਯਮਨ ॥੧੬੦॥
1423.t: dharakhhashaa shudheh teg(h) hi(n)dhee yaman ||160||
1423.e: Like lustre of the swords of Yaman.(160)

1423.g: ਚਲਾਚਲ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਕਮੰਦ ॥
1423.t: chalaachal dharaamadh kamaano kama(n)dh ||
1423.e: The bows and slingshots were brought in action,

1423.g: ਹਯਾਹਯ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਬ ਗੁਰਜੋ ਗਜ਼ੰਦ ॥੧੬੧॥
1423.t: hayaahay dharaamadh b gurajo gaza(n)dh ||161||
1423.e: And the ones beaten with maces raised hue and cries.(161)

1423.g: ਚਕਾਚਾਕ ਬਰਖ਼ਾਸਤ ਤੀਰੋ ਤੁਫ਼ੰਗ ॥
1423.t: chakaachaak barakhhaasat teero tupha(n)g ||
1423.e: Arrows and the gunshots prevailed,

1424.g: ਜ਼ਿਮੀ ਲਾਲ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਚੂੰ ਗੁਲੇ ਲਾਲਹ ਰੰਗ ॥੧੬੨॥
1424.t: zimee laal shudh choo(n) gule laaleh ra(n)g ||162||
1424.e: And the earth turned into red-flowery colour all around.(162)

1424.g: ਹਹਾਹੂ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਚੁਪਹ ਨੰਦ ਰੂੰ ॥
1424.t: hahaahoo dharaamadh chupeh na(n)dh roo(n) ||
1424.e: When the blood-sucking daggers struck out,

1424.g: ਦਿਹਾ ਦਿਹ ਸ਼ੁਦਹ ਖ਼ੰਜਰੇ ਖ਼ਾਰ ਖੂੰ ॥੧੬੩॥
1424.t: dhihaa dheh shudheh khha(n)jare khhaar khoo(n) ||163||
1424.e: The shrieks flowed from the war-zones.(163)

1424.g: ਬ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਯਕੇ ਤਾਬ ਰੰਗ ॥
1424.t: b rakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh yake taab ra(n)g ||
1424.e: When two of the steadfast warriors on the horsebacks entered the fighting,

1424.g: ਬ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਦੁ ਚਾਲਾਕ ਜੰਗ ॥੧੬੪॥
1424.t: b rakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh dh chaalaak ja(n)g ||164||
1424.e: There was lighting all around.(164)

1424.g: ਬ ਸ਼ੋਰਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਸਰਾਫ਼ੀਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
1424.t: b shorash dharaamadh saraapheel soor ||
1424.e: The way a Sraphil Angel appears and it becomes boisterous all over,

1424.g: ਬ ਰਖ਼ਸ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਆਮਦ ਤਨੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਹੂਰ ॥੧੬੫॥
1424.t: b rakhhash a(n)dhar aamadh tane khhaas hoor ||165||
1424.e: (Same way) the enemy was confused and disrupted.(165)

1424.g: ਬ ਸ਼ੋਰਸ਼ ਦਰਾਮਦ ਜ਼ਿ ਤਨ ਦਰ ਖ਼ਰੋਸ਼ ॥
1424.t: b shorash dharaamadh z tan dhar khharosh ||
1424.e: When it was raucous all around,

1424.g: ਬ ਬਾਜੂਇ ਮਰਦਾ ਬਰਾਵੁਰਦ ਜੋਸ਼ ॥੧੬੬॥
1424.t: b baajooi maradhaa baraavuradh josh ||166||
1424.e: The soldiers’ arms flickered in anger.(166)

1424.g: ਯਕੇ ਫ਼ਰਸ਼ ਆਰਾਸਤ ਸੁਰਖ਼ ਅਤਲਸੇ ॥
1424.t: yake pharash aaraasat surakhh atalase ||
1424.e: The shinning ground turned and looked as if painted in red,

1424.g: ਬੁ ਖ਼ਾਨਦ ਚੁ ਮਕਤਬ ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਪਹਿਲੂਏ ॥੧੬੭॥
1424.t: b khhaanadh ch makatab zubaa pahilooe ||167||
1424.e: The floor of a school with children reading sitting on top.(167)

1424.g: ਬ ਮਰਦਮ ਚੁਨਾ ਕੁਸ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਕਾਰਜ਼ਾਰ ॥
1424.t: b maradham chunaa kushat shudh kaarazaar ||
1424.e: Such a great number were killed,

1424.g: ਜ਼ੁਬਾ ਦਰ ਗੁਜ਼ਾਰਮ ਨਿਯਾਯਦ ਸ਼ੁਮਾਰ ॥੧੬੮॥
1424.t: zubaa dhar guzaaram niyaayadh shumaar ||168||
1424.e: That they could not be enumerated.(168)

1424.g: ਗੁਰੇਜ਼ਾ ਸ਼ਵਦ ਸ਼ਾਹਿ ਮਾਯੰਦਰਾ ॥
1424.t: gurezaa shavadh shaeh maaya(n)dharaa ||
1424.e: The king of Mayindra ran away,

1424.g: ਬ ਕੁਸ਼ਤੰਦ ਲਸ਼ਕਰ ਗਿਰਾ ਤਾ ਗਿਰਾ ॥੧੬੯॥
1424.t: b kushata(n)dh lashakar giraa taa giraa ||169||
1424.e: As most of his army was decimated.(169)

1424.g: ਕਿ ਪੁਸ਼ਤਸ਼ ਬਿਅਫ਼ਤਾਦ ਦੁਖ਼ਤਰ ਵਜ਼ੀਰ ॥
1424.t: k pushatash biaphataadh dhukhhatar vazeer ||
1424.e: The Minister’s daughter pursued him,

1424.g: ਬਿ ਬਸਤੰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਕਿ ਕਰਦੰਦ ਅਸੀਰ ॥੧੭੦॥
1424.t: b basata(n)dh o raa k karadha(n)dh aseer ||170||
1424.e: Caught him, tied him and made him prisoner.(170)

1424.g: ਬ ਨਿਜ਼ਦੇ ਬਿਯਾਵੁਰਦ ਜੋ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਖ਼ੇਸ਼ ॥
1424.t: b nizadhe biyaavuradh jo shaeh khhesh ||
1424.e: She brought the King (Mayindra) to the ruler,

1424.g: ਬਿ ਗੁਫ਼ਤਹ ਕਿ ਏ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਨ ਵੇਸ਼ ॥੧੭੧॥
1424.t: b guphateh k e shaeh shaahaan vesh ||171||
1424.e: And said, ‘Oh, you the king of kings,(171)

1424.g: ਬਿਗੋਯਦ ਕਿ ਈਂ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਮਾਯੰਦਰਾ ॥
1424.t: bigoyadh k iee(n) shaeh maaya(n)dharaa ||
1424.e: ‘He is the King of Mayindra,

1424.g: ਬਿ ਬਸਤਹ ਬਿਯਾਵੁਰਦ ਨਿਜ਼ਦੇ ਸ਼ੁਮਾ ॥੧੭੨॥
1424.t: b basateh biyaavuradh nizadhe shumaa ||172||
1424.e: ‘Whom I have brought to you tied up.(172)

1424.g: ਅਗ਼ਰ ਤੋ ਬਿਗੋਈ ਬ ਜ਼ਾ ਈਂ ਬੁਰਮ ॥
1424.t: ag(h)r to bigoiee b zaa iee(n) buram ||
1424.e: ‘If you order, I would kill him,

1424.g: ਵਗ਼ਰ ਤੋ ਬਿਗੋਈ ਬਜ਼ਿੰਦਾ ਦਿਹਮ ॥੧੭੩॥
1424.t: vag(h)r to bigoiee bazi(n)dhaa dhiham ||173||
1424.e: ‘Or I would imprison him under lock and key.’(173)

1424.g: ਬਜ਼ਿੰਦਾ ਸਪੁਰਦੰਦ ਓ ਰਾ ਅਜ਼ੀਮ ॥
1424.t: bazi(n)dhaa sapuradha(n)dh o raa azeem ||
1424.e: He was despatched to the big prison,

1424.g: ਸਿਤਾਨਦ ਅਜ਼ੋ ਤਾਜ ਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਕਲੀਮ ॥੧੭੪॥
1424.t: sitaanadh azo taaj shaahee kaleem ||174||
1424.e: And his canopy of the authority of ruling was snatched away.(174)

1424.g: ਸ਼ਹਿਨਸ਼ਾਹਗੀ ਯਾਫ਼ਤ ਹੁਕਮੋ ਰਜ਼ਾਕ ॥
1424.t: shahinashaahagee yaaphat hukamo razaak ||
1424.e: With the benevolence of the Provider, she attained the monarchy,

1424.g: ਕਸੇ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਨਾ ਰਾ ਕੁਨਦ ਚਾਕ ਚਾਕ ॥੧੭੫॥
1424.t: kase dhushamanaa raa kunadh chaak chaak ||175||
1424.e: After tearing off so many other sovereigns.(175)

1424.g: ਚੁਨਾ ਕਰਦ ਸ਼ੁਦ ਕਸਦ ਮਿਹਨਤ ਕਸੇ ॥
1424.t: chunaa karadh shudh kasadh mihanat kase ||
1424.e: Whosoever performs the deeds with such zeal,

1424.g: ਕਿ ਰਹਮਤ ਬਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਦ ਜੋ ਰਹਮਤੇ ॥੧੭੬॥
1424.t: k rahamat babakhhasheedh jo rahamate ||176||
